entries.source: To get to see spirits of the water you should go stand naked on a rock in the water at night. It must be a single rock or skerry, completely surrounded by water, and the water folk may gather around it at midnight.
entries.translation: Nähdäksesi vedenhaltijoita mene yöllä alasti seisomaan vedessä olevalle kivelle. Sen pitää olla yksittäinen kivi tai luoto, kokonaan veden ympäröimä. Vedenväki saattaa kokoontua sen ympärille keskiyöllä.

entries.source: meeting the spirit of the forest

The spirit of the forest can be met and addressed by sacrificing silver at an ant nest. You do it alone at night, and then wait for the spirit to arrive. Do not fear and he may speak and show himself to you before dawn.
entries.translation: Metsänhaltijan voi kohdata ja häntä puhutella uhraamalla hopeaa muurahaispesään. Se tehdään yksin yöllä, ja sitten odotetaan haltijan tuloa. Älä pelkää, niin hän saattaa puhua ja näyttäytyä sinulle ennen aamunkoittoa.

entries.source: When going rod fishing you should first throw the fishing rod into the water, and then you have a good fishing luck.
entries.translation: Ongelle lähtiessä onki pitää ensin heittää veteen, niin kalaonni on hyvä.

entries.source: The very first fish of the spring that you catch with a fishing rod in open water season should be thrown back into the water to please the spirit of the water and assure your future fishing luck.
entries.translation: Kevään aivan ensimmäinen ongella avovedestä saamasi kala pitää heittää takaisin veteen vedenhaltijan miellyttämiseksi ja tulevan kalaonnen turvaamiseksi.

entries.source: When first fish of the spring are caught out at a lake in open water season, make a fish soup or boil them right after returning on shore. When it's cooked, go away from the pot so that the spirit of the water can have the first taste.
entries.translation: Kun kevään ensimmäiset kalat on saatu järveltä avovesiaikana, tee niistä kalakeitto tai keitä ne heti rantaan palattuasi. Kun ruoka on kypsää, mene pois padan luota, jotta vedenhaltija saa maistaa ensin.

entries.source: You get a good catch if you step in the punt backwards and launch it in the water backwards.
entries.translation: Saat hyvän saaliin, jos astut ruuheen takaperin ja lasket sen vesille takaperin.

entries.source: making a bird thief to confess

Bird thief will come confess if you take three feathers that have remained from the stolen bird and throw them into heated sauna stove after the fire has burnt out. You can also throw the feathers into remains of burnt-out fire which was made on base rock.
entries.translation: Lintuvaras tulee tunnustamaan, jos otat kolme varastetusta linnusta jäljelle jäänyttä sulkaa ja heität ne lämmitettyyn saunankiukaaseen tulen sammuttua. Voit myös heittää sulat kalliolle tehdyn ja loppuun palaneen nuotion jäännöksiin.

entries.translation: Käänny ympäri ja potkaise puuta kantapäälläsi. Orava pysyy silloin puussa paikoillaan, vaikka se olisi aiemmin hyppinyt paljonkin.

entries.source: Have a capercaillie feather with you when chasing a lynx. The feather is then put on lynx tracks from where it first fled, on its very first escaping tracks. This will burden the lynx, making it more quickly fatigued.
entries.translation: Pidä metson sulkaa mukanasi ilvestä ajaessasi. Laita sulka ilveksen jäljille kohtaan, josta se ensimmäisen kerran lähti pakoon, aivan sen ensimmäisille pakojäljille. Se rasittaa ilvestä ja saa sen väsymään nopeammin.

entries.source: Be it birds or hares you are after, the loop snares you are about to use are made favorable by leaving them in an ant nest for three nights, and only then picked up and set for a catch.
entries.translation: Pyysitpä lintuja tai jäniksiä, silmukkapauloista tulee otolliset, kun jätät ne muurahaispesään kolmeksi yöksi ja vasta sen jälkeen nostat ja virität ne pyyntiin.

entries.source: To make a fox trap favourable leave it laying at doorstep of a building where womenfolk will get to walk over it.
entries.translation: Jätä ketunansa rakennuksen kynnykselle, jossa naiset astuvat sen yli. Näin siitä tulee suotuisa.

entries.source: making foxes to come at the bait
Baiting a fox-trap at your hunting grounds should be done just around sunset.
entries.translation: Pyyntimaiden ketunansa tulee syöttää juuri auringonlaskun aikaan.

entries.source: Loop snares for hares shouldn't be set barehanded but you should always wear mittens, and preferably woollen mittens.
entries.translation: Jäniksenpauloja ei pidä virittää paljain käsin, vaan aina kintaat kädessä, mieluiten villakintaat.

entries.source: carrying bear teeth to find hares and birds

entries.source: eth to find hares and birds
entries.translation: eth to find hares and birds

entries.source: Bear is a great hunter who always finds its prey, and hunters who carry bear teeth with them can come across hares and game birds as they please.
entries.translation: Karhu on suuri metsästäjä, joka löytää aina saaliinsa. Karhunhampaita kantavat metsästäjät löytävät jäniksiä ja riistalintuja mielin määrin.

entries.source: When deadfall trap is made for a bear you should then set the meat bait there completely naked. Then the bear gets in there nicely.
entries.translation: Kun loukku tehdään karhua varten, lihasyötti on asetettava sinne aivan alasti. Silloin karhu menee sinne hyvin.

entries.source: Bear hunter's mittens shouldn't be made of whatever material. It is the dog fur mittens you should wear in order to have your weapons to be effective and cut the bear good.
entries.translation: Karhunmetsästäjän kintaita ei pidä tehdä mistä tahansa. Sinun tulee käyttää koirannahkaisia kintaita, jotta aseesi tehoaisivat ja viiltäisivät karhua hyvin.

entries.source: releasing animal from the forest cover
Cut twigs from a living spruce tree and set them burning on the most fresh tracks of the missing animal you can find.
entries.translation: Katkaise elävästä kuusesta havuja ja sytytä ne palamaan kadonneen eläimen tuoreimmille löytämillesi jäljille.

entries.source: building a fire to attract forest maids

Forest maids are attracted to come at nighttime campfires in remote forests of spruce and moss by lighting the fire with seven spruce twigs in there along with good pile of other firewood. Sleep on the moss by such fire and they may appear.
entries.translation: Metsänneitoja voi houkutella öisin syrjäisten sammaleisten kuusimetsien nuotioille sytyttämällä tulen seitsemällä kuusenoksalla ja kunnon pinolla muuta polttopuuta. Nuku sammalella sellaisen tulen vieressä, niin he saattavat ilmestyä.

entries.source: All-round way to sacrifice something in order to please or thank the spirits and otherworldly beings in various occasions.
entries.translation: Yleinen uhraustapa henkien ja tuonpuoleisten olentojen miellyttämiseksi tai kiittämiseksi eri tilanteissa.

entries.source: Incantation to stop the wounds from bleeding.
greeting the earth upon going to sleep

Incantation to greet earth dwellers and underground creatures upon sleeping on the ground at unfamiliar terrain. Performed to assure good night sleep and to avoid being harmed by the possibly angered underground folk.
entries.translation: Loitsu maanväen ja maanalaisten olentojen tervehtimiseen, kun nukutaan maassa vieraalla seudulla. Sen tarkoituksena on turvata hyvät yöunet ja välttää mahdollisesti suuttuneen maanalaisen väen aiheuttamat vahingot.

entries.source: persuading the forest with a bread

The forest can be persuaded to not to hide its thingies when going hunting. It is done by carrying a bread with you which is dropped and left at a spruce on a hill or cliff, and then this specific incantation is cast.
entries.translation: Metsää voi suostutella olemaan kätkemättä otuksiaan metsästämään lähtiessä. Kanna mukana leipää, pudota ja jätä se kukkulalla tai jyrkänteellä olevan kuusen luo ja lausu sitten tämä loitsu.

entries.source: !You can build that only inside of a building, in a location that has a floor and ceiling present!
entries.translation: !Voit rakentaa sen vain rakennuksen sisään paikkaan, jossa on lattia ja katto!

entries.source: !The framework center here should be left open and intact.
entries.translation: !Kehikon keskikohta on jätettävä avoimeksi ja ehjäksi.

entries.source: !Placing {arg1} there is either too far or incorrectly aligned from the framework center!
entries.translation: !Tämän sijoitus on liian kaukana tai väärässä linjassa rungon keskipisteeseen nähden: {arg1}!

entries.source: !The location must be an open area and free of obstacles!
!You can't build a ceiling there yet! There needs to be more solid structures, walls or surrounding ceiling around first.
entries.translation: !Et voi vielä rakentaa kattoa siihen! Ympärillä täytyy ensin olla enemmän tukevia rakenteita, seiniä tai kattoa.

entries.source: !You can build a door only to a location in between two solid walls or structures!
entries.translation: !Oven voi rakentaa vain kahden kiinteän seinän tai rakennelman väliin!

entries.source: !The chosen location being the framework center there should also be open area all around it!
entries.translation: !Valittu paikka on kehikon keskikohta, joten sen ympärillä on oltava avointa tilaa!

entries.source: !The chosen location must be clear of any objects.
entries.translation: !Valitun paikan on oltava tyhjä kaikista esineistä.

entries.source: Ok. Kota may be now built around the framework in a free form with maximum diameter of six meters from wall to wall.
entries.translation: Hyvä. Kodan voi nyt rakentaa vapaamuotoisesti kehikon ympärille. Suurin halkaisija seinästä seinään on kuusi metriä.

entries.source: We met that evening by the light of the fireside, and to my eyes he was the most handsome man I had ever seen. He had a way about him that made the village men listen to his words. entries.source: He remembers nothing but having fainted outside our village, and then coming back to his senses further in the woods while devouring a bread. Having lost his clothes and being surrounded by wolf tracks he figured what had happened. But he managed to return, I gave him some supplies and he's back in the woods to recover now. I'm about to follow him soon, but first let me reward you with something that only a woman like me can offer.
entries.translation: Hän muistaa vain pyörtyneensä kylämme ulkopuolella ja heränneensä sitten syvemmällä metsässä leipää ahmien. Kun vaatteet olivat poissa ja ympärillä oli sudenjälkiä, hän ymmärsi, mitä oli tapahtunut. Mutta hän pääsi palaamaan, annoin hänelle tarvikkeita ja nyt hän on taas metsässä toipumassa. Aion seurata häntä pian, mutta ensin tahdon palkita sinut jollakin, mitä vain kaltaiseni nainen voi tarjota.

entries.translation: Toden totta! Onni oli, ettei siitä tullut viimeistä kertaa, kun kuljin metsissä seudulla {arg1}. Nurin se armoton joukko!

entries.source: Do you know who they are?|TALKLINE  4:I can tell you that. I saw them real close with my own eyes.
entries.translation: Do you know who they are?|TALKLINE  4:I can tell you that. I saw them real close with my own eyes.

entries.source: It was a blessing in disguise that I met them. See, I was on a hunting trip but got a bit lost.
entries.translation: It was a blessing in disguise that I met them. See, I was on a hunting trip but got a bit lost.

entries.source: The day went by as I circled around trying to relocate myself and in the late evening I picked up a smell of smoke.
entries.translation: The day went by as I circled around trying to relocate myself and in the late evening I picked up a smell of smoke.

entries.source: Figuring it might be a camp of local woodsman I headed towards the smoke hoping to find someone to ask directions from. But instead of good people I found those robbers sitting by a campfire!
entries.translation: Figuring it might be a camp of local woodsman I headed towards the smoke hoping to find someone to ask directions from. But instead of good people I found those robbers sitting by a campfire!

entries.source: They are one filthy band of {arg1} men - I took a notice of that. And there were {arg2} of them, all armed and fit.
entries.translation: He ovat likainen joukko {arg1} miehiä, sen huomasin. Heitä oli {arg2}, kaikki aseistettuja ja hyväkuntoisia.

entries.source: As soon as they noticed me they grabbed their blades and stepped forward.
entries.translation: As soon as they noticed me they grabbed their blades and stepped forward.

entries.source: Only then I realized having faced the danger and looking at these rumoured robbers with my own eyes.
entries.translation: Only then I realized having faced the danger and looking at these rumoured robbers with my own eyes.

entries.source: One of them commanded me to hand over my belongings and others joked about robbing at {arg1} getting boringly easy.
entries.translation: Yksi käski luovuttaa tavarani. Muut vitsailivat, että ryöstely alueella ({arg1}) on käynyt tylsän helpoksi.

entries.source: So, what did you do?|TALKLINE 6:I don't take commands from robbers! But I'm no hero either...

entries.source: I see you survived, so let's waste no more time. Just tell me where you met them?|TALKLINE 7:Oh. Okay. But I'm not too sure of it.
entries.translation: I see you survived, so let's waste no more time. Just tell me where you met them?|TALKLINE 7:Oh. Okay. But I'm not too sure of it.

entries.source: I escaped. There were {arg1} of them and I couldn't have fought such a band of armed {arg2} men alone.
entries.translation: Pakenin. Heitä oli {arg1}, enkä olisi voinut yksin taistella sellaista aseistettua miesjoukkoa vastaan ({arg2}).

entries.source: I kept running aimlessly and managed to escape unharmed.
entries.translation: I kept running aimlessly and managed to escape unharmed.

entries.source: If I was lost already now it took two full days to relocate myself and find finally a way back home.
entries.translation: Jos olinkin jo eksynyt, minulta meni kaksi täyttä päivää sijaintini selvittämiseen ja lopulta kotitien löytämiseen.

entries.source: Early in the morning, as I was gathering branches for a fire, I suddenly stumbled into an angry {arg1}. I tried to disengage, but the {arg2} kept following me, and eventually we fought.
entries.translation: Varhain aamulla keräsin oksia tulentekoon, kun yhtäkkiä törmäsin vihaiseen eläimeen ({arg1}). Yritin irrottautua, mutta eläin ({arg2}) seurasi minua, ja lopulta taistelimme.

entries.source: I had nothing but my knife to wield as I had left everything else by the shelter.
entries.translation: Minulla oli aseeksi vain veitsi, sillä olin jättänyt kaiken muun suojan luo.

entries.source: Good that you survived! Where was that?|TALKLINE 7

entries.source: The beast managed to hit me hard couple of times until I landed a fierce counter-strike which made it to retreat into the woods.

entries.source: My equipment was at the shelter, but afraid of the {arg1} still around I didn't dare to go get them and left while still conscious.

entries.source: I was bleeding bad, but determined to survive and crawled my way to this village.
entries.translation: Vuosin pahasti verta, mutta päätin selvitä hengissä ja ryömin tähän kylään.

entries.source: I have vague recollection of the shelter location, and if you go quickly there still might be bloodscapes and {arg1} tracks to be found.

entries.source: I have been trapping birds quite successfully for a long time but lately I started to find my snares emptied. Consistently. Somebody keeps stealing my winged prey.
entries.translation: Olen pyytänyt lintuja ansoilla menestyksekkäästi pitkään, mutta viime aikoina paulani ovat olleet tyhjiä. Kerta toisensa jälkeen. Joku varastaa siivekkään saaliini.

entries.source: Have you investigated it further?|TALKLINE 5:Only enough to be sure it's a two legged thief in question.
entries.translation: Have you investigated it further?|TALKLINE 5:Only enough to be sure it's a two legged thief in question.

entries.source: Who could this somebody be?|TALKLINE 6:That is what I would like to find out.
entries.translation: Who could this somebody be?|TALKLINE 6:That is what I would like to find out.

entries.source: I've found footprints and feathers by the triggered snares, but never any bloodscapes to indicate the birds being taken by animals. If you need to see it for yourself you can visit my last trapping site.
entries.translation: I've found footprints and feathers by the triggered snares, but never any bloodscapes to indicate the birds being taken by animals. If you need to see it for yourself you can visit my last trapping site.

entries.source: It's the usual sight there, and it wasn't the first time at all. Now I don't have the nerve to continue trapping until the thief is revealed.
entries.translation: Se on siellä tavallinen näky, eikä se ollut ensimmäinen kerta. En uskalla jatkaa pyyntiä ennen kuin varas paljastuu.

entries.source: Any ideas who the thief might be?|TALKLINE 6:No idea. Maybe one of us, maybe someone from neighbouring villages.
entries.translation: Any ideas who the thief might be?|TALKLINE 6:No idea. Maybe one of us, maybe someone from neighbouring villages.

entries.source: Now where can I find that trapping site of yours?|TALKLINE 7:It's not far.

entries.translation: Couldn't you just set an ambush for the thief?|TALKLINE 8:Direct encounter is not an option now.

entries.source: I don't suspect anyone specifically, but I certainly want the thief to be revealed in a righteous manner. But if I go asking around I fear it might cause bad blood among the neighbourhood.
entries.translation: En epäile ketään erityisesti, mutta tahdon varmasti varkaan paljastuvan oikeamielisesti. Jos itse alan kysellä, pelkään sen aiheuttavan pahaa verta naapurustossa.

entries.source: I understand. But what can you do?|TALKLINE 10:There's a way, but it's a bit complicated.
entries.translation: I understand. But what can you do?|TALKLINE 10:There's a way, but it's a bit complicated.

entries.source: What do you mean by righteous manner?|TALKLINE 8:In this case it comes down to relying on designated spells.
entries.translation: What do you mean by righteous manner?|TALKLINE 8:In this case it comes down to relying on designated spells.

entries.source: Sounds troublesome. I can do nothing but wish you good luck.|REJECT:Luck, huh? It doesn't help me now, but thanks anyway.
entries.translation: Sounds troublesome. I can do nothing but wish you good luck.|REJECT:Luck, huh? It doesn't help me now, but thanks anyway.

entries.source: My last trapping site lies {arg1} at {arg2}.
I abandoned it right after discovering the theft and left the emptied snares and everything untouched.
entries.translation: Hylkäsin paikan heti varkauden huomattuani ja jätin tyhjennetyt ansat ja kaiken muunkin koskematta.

entries.source: Stealing somebody's catch is a serious offense and I don't want anybody to get needlessly hurt, nor falsely accused. And...should this thief know harmful witchcraft he might cast hardship on you from a distance.
entries.translation: Toisen saaliin varastaminen on vakava rikkomus, enkä tahdo kenenkään loukkaantuvan turhaan tai joutuvan väärin syytetyksi. Ja... jos varas osaa vahingollista noituutta, hän saattaa aiheuttaa sinulle vaikeuksia kaukaa.

entries.source: There are spells for revealing bird thieves, you know. And old bird hunters around here must know some of those. But it is awkward for me to approach my fellow villagers in this matter, especially as I don't know who the thief might be.
entries.translation: Lintuvarastajien paljastamiseen on taikoja, tiedäthän. Tämän seudun vanhojen linnunmetsästäjien täytyy tuntea niitä. Minun on kuitenkin kiusallista lähestyä kyläläisiä tässä asiassa, varsinkin kun en tiedä, kuka varas voisi olla.

entries.source: Blah. I would rather set an ambush for the thief.|TALKLINE 8
entries.translation: Blah. I would rather set an ambush for the thief.|TALKLINE 8

entries.source: ther set an ambush for the thief.|TALKLINE 8
entries.translation: ther set an ambush for the thief.|TALKLINE 8

entries.source: Maybe so, but this doesn't concern me.|REJECT:Begone then.
entries.translation: Maybe so, but this doesn't concern me.|REJECT:Begone then.

entries.source: I've heard about spells to make bird thieves confess. I just fear it would draw too much attention if I go asking instructions, or performing spells, on my own. This needs to be judged by a spell - if there only was a fair {arg1} to do it on my behalf.
entries.translation: Olen kuullut taioista, jotka saavat lintuvarastajan tunnustamaan. Pelkään vain, että herättäisin liikaa huomiota kyselemällä ohjeita tai tekemällä taikoja itse. Tämä on tuomittava taialla, kunpa löytyisi oikeamielinen {arg1} tekemään se puolestani.

entries.source: Then let me help you.|TALKLINE 15:That would be a noble deed! I already do have a hunch about who you could talk to.
entries.translation: Then let me help you.|TALKLINE 15:That would be a noble deed! I already do have a hunch about who you could talk to.

entries.source: I might try to help you...but would you compensate my efforts somehow?|TALKLINE 14:I would like to, but I need to think about the way to do so.
entries.translation: I might try to help you...but would you compensate my efforts somehow?|TALKLINE 14:I would like to, but I need to think about the way to do so.

entries.source: Sounds complicated. I can do nothing but wish you good luck.|REJECT:So be it, but I'm afraid this can't be solved with luck.
entries.translation: Sounds complicated. I can do nothing but wish you good luck.|REJECT:So be it, but I'm afraid this can't be solved with luck.

entries.source: I don't have wealth to offer, but I ask you to trust that I'll find a little something precious to give you if you help me and things work out.
entries.translation: Minulla ei ole rikkauksia tarjottavana, mutta luota siihen, että löydän jotakin pientä ja arvokasta annettavaksi, jos autat ja kaikki onnistuu.

entries.source: Our {arg1} might know spells for the purpose, but it may be a different story to get him to speak.
entries.translation: Meidän {arg1} saattaa tietää sopivia taikoja, mutta hänen saamisensa puhumaan onkin toinen juttu.

entries.source: I'll lay low now and hope that you'll learn to do what it takes. Oh, and visit my last trapping site if you need to examine the traces of theft.
entries.translation: Pysyn nyt piilossa ja toivon, että opit tekemään tarvittavan. Käy myös viimeisellä pyyntipaikallani, jos haluat tutkia varkauden jälkiä.

entries.source: Your last trapping site?|TALKLINE 7:It's the usual sight there, and it wasn't the first time at all.
entries.translation: Your last trapping site?|TALKLINE 7:It's the usual sight there, and it wasn't the first time at all.

entries.source: Very well. I will do my best.|EXIT:I can't thank you enough. Good luck, and let me know how it goes.
entries.translation: Very well. I will do my best.|EXIT:I can't thank you enough. Good luck, and let me know how it goes.

entries.source: I guess the bird thief case isn't solved yet, or let me know if you've figured out something.
entries.translation: Lintuvarkaan tapaus taitaa yhä olla ratkaisematta. Kerro, jos olet keksinyt jotakin.

entries.source: Umm...what bird thief?|TALKLINE 11:The one who has been snatching birds from my snares. Remember?

entries.source: I guess now we just have to wait for the results. Whoever the thief might be I'm under impression he should now come to me and confess. Maybe after few days we'll know who it was, so let's wait and talk again after a while.
entries.translation: Nyt meidän kai pitää vain odottaa tuloksia. Kuka varas lieneekin, käsittääkseni hänen pitäisi nyt tulla luokseni tunnustamaan. Ehkä muutaman päivän päästä tiedämme, kuka se oli. Odotetaan siis ja puhutaan taas jonkin ajan kuluttua.

entries.source: Alright. Let's do like that.|EXIT:Good. Talk to you again then.

entries.source: So we'll wait and hope that the thief eventually comes forward.|EXIT:Let's do like that. Maybe we'll be wiser tomorrow.
entries.translation: So we'll wait and hope that the thief eventually comes forward.|EXIT:Let's do like that. Maybe we'll be wiser tomorrow.

entries.source: You know what, <plr_identity>, it did happen! The thief came to visit me and confessed it all. Whatever you did, it worked!
entries.translation: Tiedätkö mitä, <plr_identity>, se tapahtui! Varas tuli luokseni ja tunnusti kaiken. Mitä sitten teitkin, se toimi!

entries.translation: Oh! Now who was it, and what did he say?|TALKLINE 27:This thief wasn't our own people, but one of our neighbours.

entries.source: It was {arg1} from the village {arg2}. He confessed and apologized but didn't say much more and left hastily. Sweaty he was, and looked like not having slept for days.
entries.translation: Se oli {arg1} kylästä {arg2}. Hän tunnusti ja pyysi anteeksi, mutta ei sanonut juuri muuta ja lähti kiireesti. Hikinen hän oli ja näytti siltä kuin ei olisi nukkunut moneen päivään.

entries.source: Very good! I guess my work is done here.|TALKLINE 28:Yes, and I've made up my mind about how to thank you.
entries.translation: Very good! I guess my work is done here.|TALKLINE 28:Yes, and I've made up my mind about how to thank you.

entries.source: I have this lucky {arg1} which I now want to give you.
entries.translation: Minulla on tämä onnea tuova esine ({arg1}), jonka haluan nyt antaa sinulle.

entries.source: It's actually partial reason for my success with birds, but now I think my lucky catches also made people envious.

entries.source: I've had my share of this lucky charm and I hope it turns out to be a fine reward for you.

entries.source: Apply the paw when you desire luck with any attempt at all, but do so within reason as it will wear out in use.
entries.translation: Käytä käpälää, kun kaipaat onnea mihin tahansa yritykseen, mutta kohtuudella: se kuluu käytössä.

entries.translation: Olen kohdannut elämäni aikana muutaman kumpaakin, ja tiedän myös keinot tulla kummankin kanssa toimeen tarvittaessa.

entries.translation: Puhun siitä vain linnustajille. Jos haluat tietää, osoita olevasi sen arvoinen. Pyydä lintu ja tuo se minulle, niin jutellaan.

entries.translation: Joku taisi tehdä taian. Minua alkoi polttaa kuumuus, hikoilin koko päivän enkä saanut juuri nukuttua. Muutaman päivän kärsittyäni minun oli pakko mennä tunnustamaan, ja sen jälkeen oloni helpotti.

entries.source: I have never had much luck with anything, so... But it's over now, and this is all I have to say about it.
entries.translation: Minulla ei ole koskaan ollut paljon onnea missään, joten... Mutta se on nyt ohi, ja siinä kaikki, mitä minulla on siitä sanottavaa.

entries.source: You are handing your hare's paw to me? I know what it is. A lucky charm surely suits me, but this is all too kind.
entries.translation: Annatko jäniksenkäpäläsi minulle? Tiedän, mikä se on. Onnenkalu sopii minulle kyllä, mutta tämä on aivan liian ystävällistä.

entries.source: I was roaming a familiar trail, and then all of a sudden I couldn't recognize the terrain anymore. The forest got completely silent and I felt like I was walking in a thick fog. I ended up just circling around aimlessly for days. I'm not sure, but maybe I had gotten in the forest cover. Then it went away and the forest seemed familiar again, but I'm still so very disoriented.
entries.translation: Kuljin tuttua polkua, ja yhtäkkiä en enää tunnistanut maastoa. Metsä hiljeni täysin, ja tuntui kuin olisin kävellyt sankassa sumussa. Päädyin vain kiertämään päämäärättömästi ympyrää päiväkausia. En ole varma, mutta ehkä olin joutunut metsänpeittoon. Sitten se väistyi ja metsä näytti taas tutulta, mutta olen yhä hyvin sekaisin suunnista.

entries.source: I've heard that if you get frightened in the forest you may end up in the forest cover. The forest covers you, and you go missing as the forest folk takes you within the world of spirits. It's all different and backwards there, and that's how I felt. entries.source: I see you have done a good share of fishing during your days, so I reckoned it's time for somebody to share the lore about water folk with you. See, I would be glad to tell you the essentials about lake dwellers and spirits of the water. The things that you must learn eventually, if you are to get along well with the water folk.
entries.translation: Näen sinun kalastaneen elämäsi aikana paljon, joten arvelin, että jonkun on aika jakaa sinulle vedenväen perimätietoa. Kerron mielelläni perusteet järvien asukeista ja vedenhaltijoista. Nämä asiat sinun on lopulta opittava, jos tahdot tulla hyvin toimeen vedenväen kanssa.

entries.source: Each and every lake, even the smallest ponds, have a guardian spirit of their own dwelling in depths, ruling and watching over their waters. The force of the water is the most powerful kind, and spirits of the water are mighty and moody beings. Some are helpful, some are cranky, but all are to be respected. Be aware of that, and also that they can sometimes appear for us people if it comes to that.
entries.translation: Jokaisella järvellä, pienimmälläkin lammella, on syvyyksissään oma suojelushaltijansa, joka hallitsee ja varjelee sen vesiä. Veden väki on voimista mahtavin, ja vedenhaltijat ovat voimakkaita ja oikukkaita olentoja. Jotkut auttavat, jotkut ovat äreitä, mutta kaikkia pitää kunnioittaa. Muista se ja myös se, että he voivat joskus näyttäytyä meille ihmisille, jos asia niin vaatii.

entries.source: On rare occasion the old lake dwellers may come to loyal fisherman's campfire with important matters to reveal, but normally it is us who need to seek an audience with spirits of the water. Learning to meet them is desirable, especially for those who live off the waters. Mmm. And I am here to advise you about how, where and when you might get to see the water folk yourself.

Heidän kohtaamistaan kannattaa opetella, varsinkin jos elää vesien antimista. Mmm. Olen tässä neuvomassa, miten, missä ja milloin saatat itse nähdä vedenväkeä.

entries.source: Spirits of the water can appear in many forms. They may dress in reeds and grass, and their voice is always bright, like a woman's. The oldest and mightiest lake dwellers are bowed long-bearded gaffers. The younger ones often appear as graceful men with reddish skin, big brown eyes and long black hair. Oh, but I'm quite sure you will recognize the spirit of the water when you meet one.
entries.translation: Vedenhaltiat voivat näyttäytyä monissa muodoissa. He saattavat pukeutua ruokoihin ja ruohoon, ja heidän äänensä on aina kirkas, kuin naisen. Vanhimmat ja mahtavimmat järvenasukit ovat kumaria pitkäpartaisia ukkoja. Nuoremmat näyttävät usein solakoilta miehiltä, joilla on punertava iho, suuret ruskeat silmät ja pitkät mustat hiukset. Mutta uskon kyllä, että tunnistat vedenhaltijan sen kohdatessasi.

entries.source: Upon meeting spirits of the water, however it happens, do nothing but wait and observe. They rarely say a word, but their appearance reveals how things are. If they look gentle, or wear decorative clothes, it means they are pleased with you and good fish catches shall be given. But if they look gloomy then it's misfortunes and hardships to be feared, or sacrifices best to be performed.
entries.translation: Kun kohtaat vedenhaltijoita, tapahtuipa se miten tahansa, älä tee muuta kuin odota ja tarkkaile. He sanovat harvoin sanaakaan, mutta ulkomuoto kertoo asioiden tilan. Jos he näyttävät lempeiltä tai käyttävät koristeellisia vaatteita, he ovat sinuun tyytyväisiä ja lupaavat hyviä kalansaaliita. Jos he näyttävät synkiltä, on syytä pelätä epäonnea ja vaikeuksia tai mieluiten toimittaa uhreja.

entries.source: It is evident that you can find the trails and hunt the game, so the spirits of the forest surely have been fond of you at times. But the spirit of the forest is also a ruler you better know closely if you are to thrive in his realm. So, I reckoned it's time for somebody to tell you the essentials about these matters. I've watched you, and I consider you worthy of the lore.
entries.translation: Löydät selvästi jäljet ja osaat metsästää riistaa, joten metsänhaltiat ovat varmasti joskus olleet sinuun mieltyneitä. Mutta metsänhaltija on myös hallitsija, joka on syytä tuntea hyvin, jos aiot menestyä hänen valtakunnassaan. Arvelin siis, että jonkun on aika kertoa sinulle näiden asioiden perusteet. Olen tarkkaillut sinua ja pidän sinua tiedon arvoisena.

entries.source: There are many otherwordly beings in the woods, but the mightiest is the spirit of the forest who rules over the forest and its animal. Hunters therefore have to observe certain rules, make sacrifices, and appease the spirits whose realm they roam. Each forest has a ruler of its own, and everything we hunt is theirs. Means to gain their favour are numerous but best assured if the spirit of the forest is met in person.
entries.translation: Metsissä on monia tuonpuoleisia olentoja, mutta mahtavin on metsänhaltija, joka hallitsee metsää ja sen eläimiä. Siksi metsästäjien pitää noudattaa tiettyjä sääntöjä, uhrata ja lepyttää henkiä, joiden valtakunnassa he kulkevat. Jokaisella metsällä on oma hallitsijansa, ja kaikki pyytämämme kuuluu heille. Suosion saamiseen on monia keinoja, mutta sen varmistaa parhaiten kohtaamalla metsänhaltijan itse.

entries.source: Rarely does the spirit of the forest appear spontaneously before one's eyes. Should that happen it is usually a display of great satisfaction, or fury. It has to be important matters for the spirit of the forest to address people. But there are means to summon the spirit of the forest for an audience - a way for a hunter to seek advice as well to maintain good terms with the forest. You might dare to learn and make use of these ways.
entries.translation: Metsänhaltija näyttäytyy harvoin oma-aloitteisesti. Jos niin käy, se osoittaa yleensä suurta tyytyväisyyttä tai vihaa. Asioiden pitää olla tärkeitä, jotta metsänhaltija puhuttelee ihmisiä. Mutta haltijan voi myös kutsua puheilleen. Näin metsästäjä voi pyytää neuvoa ja ylläpitää hyviä välejä metsän kanssa. Saatat uskaltaa opetella näitä tapoja ja käyttää niitä.

entries.source: The spirit of the forest appears in form of an old man with extremely long beard, which is grey like tree lichen. He is quite a sight, and quite often even dressed in lichen and moss. He may first appear tall as the forest itself, peeking over the tree tops, but then walk at you as a mere short old man. Despite of varying appearance spirits of the forest all wear one thing in common, their recognizable grey hat.
entries.translation: Metsänhaltija näyttäytyy vanhana miehenä, jolla on hyvin pitkä, naavanharmaa parta. Hän on melkoinen näky ja pukeutuu usein jäkälään ja sammaleeseen. Aluksi hän saattaa näyttää metsän korkuiselta ja kurkistaa puiden latvojen yli, mutta kävelee sitten luoksesi pelkkänä pienenä ukkona. Vaihtelevasta ulkomuodosta huolimatta kaikilla metsänhaltijoilla on yksi yhteinen asia: tunnusomainen harmaa hattu.

entries.source: The custom is to let the spirit do the talking. Don't fear, let the spirit approach, and listen to how the forest feels about you. A pleased spirit examines you with gentle big brown eyes, but an upset one faces you with a gloomy expression. His appearance speaks for itself, and if he decides to speak the words may lash, advice or praise you. The favoured hunters may be told where the game roams, or made aware of other important matters.
entries.translation: Tapana on antaa haltijan puhua. Älä pelkää, vaan anna sen lähestyä ja kuuntele, mitä metsä sinusta ajattelee. Tyytyväinen haltija tarkastelee sinua lempein suurin ruskein silmin, mutta suuttuneen ilme on synkkä. Olemus puhuu puolestaan, ja jos hän päättää puhua, sanat voivat ruoskia, neuvoa tai ylistää. Suosituille metsästäjille saatetaan kertoa riistan olinpaikka tai muita tärkeitä asioita.

entries.source: An angered spirit of the forest may revenge with sickness or getting you lost. To stay on good terms make good use of the hunting spells, and rely on sacrifices to give back for what you have received. Spells and means to address the forest are numerous, but meeting the spirit proves how your alliance really holds. That is all. Now I only wish that one day, you can tell me that you really are the kind whom the spirit of the forest appeared for.
entries.translation: Suututettu metsänhaltija voi kostaa sairaudella tai eksyttämällä sinut. Pysy hyvissä väleissä käyttämällä metsästystaikoja ja uhraamalla vastalahjoja saamastasi saaliista. Metsälle on monia taikoja ja puhuttelutapoja, mutta haltijan kohtaaminen osoittaa, miten liittonne todella pitää. Siinä kaikki. Toivon vain, että jonakin päivänä voit kertoa olevasi todella sellainen, jolle metsänhaltija näyttäytyi.

entries.source: Stay away from angering the spirit of the forest. Always be humble and modest, and you'll be favoured. Over time you'll learn more from your own experience. But now, there is this one spell I would like to teach you. It is {arg1}, which is something to bear in mind if you'd like to see your trapping and hunting prosperous.

entries.source: We live the transition period now. Summer season is passing and the winter is coming. The spirits, the dead and the forest folk move about more actively and freely these days. As the nights grow darker also the forest maids are more keen to find their way at lone campfires.

entries.review_required: numeric_inflection_review

entries.source: They tend to come at nighttime campfires of those who they fancy. That's how it went with {arg1} too. He was always keen to meet them, and eventually he did. Maybe it goes the same for you too. And should that happen, I would be delighted to hear about it.
entries.translation: He tulevat mielellään öisin suosimiensa kulkijoiden nuotioille. Niin kävi myös miehelle nimeltä {arg1}. Hän tahtoi aina kovasti tavata heidät ja lopulta tapasikin. Ehkä sinulle käy samoin. Jos niin tapahtuu, kuulisin siitä mielelläni.

entries.source: If they ever reward you with something it's usually to be found behind nearby trees or so. Whatever you may receive, keep it to yourself and never tell anyone how you got it. Otherwise it disappears or gets ruined.
entries.translation: Jos he palkitsevat sinut jollakin, se löytyy yleensä läheisten puiden takaa tai sieltä main. Mitä saatkin, pidä se omana tietonasi äläkä koskaan kerro kenellekään, miten sait sen. Muuten se katoaa tai turmeltuu.

entries.source: Thank you for your guidance.|EXIT:Take care, and stay in good terms with the forest folk.

entries.source: I truly met a forest maid last year while working in the woods. Sleeping under the open sky I woke up one night to a pretty maid standing next to my campfire, smiling at me. Then she came and snuggled beside me. I was mesmerized by her beauty, and soon fell asleep again.
entries.translation: Tapasin tosiaan metsänneidon viime vuonna ollessani metsätöissä. Nukuin taivasalla ja heräsin eräänä yönä siihen, että kaunis neito seisoi nuotioni vieressä ja hymyili minulle. Sitten hän tuli kainalooni. Hänen kauneutensa lumosi minut, ja pian nukahdin uudelleen.

entries.source: Sounds like a pleasant encounter.|TALKLINE 4:So far it was. But then it turned unpleasant.
entries.translation: Sounds like a pleasant encounter.|TALKLINE 4:So far it was. But then it turned unpleasant.

entries.source: When I woke up, the fire was out, and she stood in the distance asking me to follow. It was still dark, but I went, following her far from the campsite. Suddendly she turned and I saw the backside. It looked all hollow or barklike. I startled and she just disappeared among the trees.
entries.translation: Kun heräsin, tuli oli sammunut ja hän seisoi kauempana pyytäen minua seuraamaan. Oli yhä pimeää, mutta menin hänen perässään kauas leiriltä. Yhtäkkiä hän kääntyi ja näin selkäpuolen. Se näytti aivan ontolta tai kaarnamaiselta. Säikähdin, ja hän vain katosi puiden sekaan.

entries.source: And, that's it?|TALKLINE 5:The forest maid was gone, yes, but my troubles continued.
entries.translation: And, that's it?|TALKLINE 5:The forest maid was gone, yes, but my troubles continued.

entries.source: I was freezing and frightened and barely found back to the camp, only to notice that I couldn't remember where I had left my axe. So, unfortunately I had to return back to the village. That's it. Now if you too are about to laugh behind me back go ask my uncle about these things.
entries.translation: Palelin ja olin peloissani. Löysin vaivoin takaisin leiriin vain huomatakseni, etten muistanut, minne olin jättänyt kirveeni. Niinpä jouduin valitettavasti palaamaan kylään. Siinä kaikki. Jos sinäkin aiot nauraa selkäni takana, mene kysymään näistä asioista sedältäni.

entries.source: Your uncle?|TALKLINE 6:I told you my story, and he is the one who can confirm.

entries.source: They dwell in distant forests of spruce and moss. This transition from summer to winter, the fall and dirt months, it is their time. Spend the night alone at spruce mire, sleeping on moss by the campfire, and you might meet them. That is, if they find you appealing, or you follow the means to attract them.
entries.translation: He asuvat kaukaisissa sammaleisissa kuusimetsissä. Tämä siirtymä kesästä talveen, syys- ja lokakuut, on heidän aikaansa. Vietä yö yksin kuusikorvessa, nukkuen sammalella nuotion vieressä, niin saatat kohdata heidät. Siis jos he mieltyvät sinuun tai noudatat keinoja heidän houkuttelemisekseen.

entries.source: What is it like to meet them?|TALKLINE 4:It depends. They treat you and speak to you as they find you.

entries.source: They can tease and seduce, but also to favour and reward. There are rumors of their most dearest being rewarded with clothes that never wear out, but I wouldn't know about that. Should you ever meet a forest maid my advise is to stay put, wait for her initiative and see where it goes.
entries.translation: He voivat kiusoitella ja vietellä, mutta myös suosia ja palkita. Huhutaan, että heidän rakkaimpansa ovat saaneet vaatteita, jotka eivät koskaan kulu, mutta siitä minä en tiedä. Jos kohtaat metsänneidon, neuvon pysymään aloillasi, odottamaan hänen aloitettaan ja katsomaan, mihin se johtaa.

entries.source: He worked hard for the day and dreamed hard for the night, then woke up in the morning with mouthful of moss and hugging a tree stump. That's what I think. Poor {arg1} lost an axe there and just had to come up with a story. Tale of a generous forest maid sure is the kind his fellows enjoy listening.
entries.translation: Hän teki päivällä kovasti töitä ja yöllä näki kovasti unia, sitten heräsi aamulla suu täynnä sammalta puunkantoa halaten. Niin minä arvelen. {arg1}-parka hukkasi siellä kirveen ja joutui keksimään tarinan. Antelias metsänneito on varmasti sellainen tarina, jota hänen toverinsa kuuntelevat mielellään.

For sure I went after it, searching and calling, and followed the trail until it went cold but I swear the {arg2} was nowhere to be found. It's been days without a trace or {arg3} of it and I'm starting to fear it really may have gotten in the forest cover.
entries.translation: Olin huolimaton, ja {arg1} karkasi minulta aivan kylän ulkopuolella. Toki lähdin sen perään, etsin ja kutsuin ja seurasin jälkiä niiden loppuun asti, mutta vannon, ettei {arg2} löytynyt mistään. Päiviin ei ole näkynyt jälkiä eikä kuulunut {arg3}, ja alan pelätä sen todella joutuneen metsänpeittoon.

entries.source:
There are countless stories, legends and myths about The First Winter.
During The First Winter, the Inehmo became many.
Men, wives, children, the heroes and the wise ones walked the Earth.
The heroes made the fire, they made the bow and the arrow and they hunted.
They made clothes, they made tools and shelters, they made skis,
and they made drums and the kantele.
When The First Winter was over,
Inehmoes could not understand The Wind singing,
nor The Bear and The Forest humming.
The wise ones among the people said that The World was no longer real.
The World was Unreal.
entries.translation:
Ensimmäisestä talvesta on lukemattomia tarinoita, legendoja ja myyttejä.
Ensimmäisen talven aikana Inehmoja tuli paljon.
Miehet, vaimot, lapset, sankarit ja tietäjät kulkivat maata.
Sankarit tekivät tulen, jousen ja nuolen ja metsästivät.
He tekivät vaatteita, työkaluja ja suojia, he tekivät suksia
sekä rumpuja ja kanteleen.
Kun ensimmäinen talvi päättyi,
Inehmoot eivät enää ymmärtäneet Tuulen laulua
eivätkä Karhun ja Metsän hyrinää.
Ihmisten tietäjät sanoivat, ettei maailma ollut enää todellinen.
Maailma oli epätodellinen.

entries.source:
Your character possesses the following selection of cultural and family skills which can be now developed further. You have number of options to assign to the skills you prefer. Select a skill from the list and press [+] or [-] to improve or degrade it.

The darker section of skill meter bar, if visible, shows your initial skill mastery.

Your natural aptitude for learning and developing a skill is rated by stars * . This is determined by your physical and mental attributes and affects the level of skill improvement.
entries.translation:
Hahmollasi on seuraavat kansalta ja suvulta opitut taidot, joita voit nyt kehittää. Sinulla on tietty määrä muutoksia jaettavaksi haluamiisi taitoihin. Valitse taito luettelosta ja paina [+] tai [-] parantaaksesi tai heikentääksesi sitä.

Taitomittarin tummempi osa näyttää alkutason, jos se on näkyvissä.

Luontainen taipumuksesi taidon oppimiseen ja kehittämiseen arvioidaan tähdillä *. Se määräytyy fyysisistä ja henkisistä ominaisuuksistasi ja vaikuttaa taidon kehitykseen.

entries.source: There's more information available about highlighted topics. To display a page, choose and select the topic by using the cursor keys and ENTER - or by clicking with the mouse. You can also type a free keyword/topic to search for a specific page.
entries.translation: Korostetuista aiheista on lisätietoa. Avaa sivu valitsemalla aihe nuolinäppäimillä ja ENTERillä tai napsauttamalla hiirellä. Voit myös kirjoittaa vapaan hakusanan tai aiheen etsiäksesi tiettyä sivua.

entries.source: Now pick and select a start-up scenario you wish to start with. All the other scenarios except the first one, The Unreal World, give you a rough background and a plot you can start to follow.
entries.translation: Valitse nyt haluamasi alkutilanne. Ensimmäistä, UnReal Worldia, lukuun ottamatta kaikki tilanteet antavat hahmollesi karkean taustan ja juonen, jota voit alkaa seurata.

entries.source: Tasks to teach you the basics of wilderness survival and to test your survival skills as you roam across the land and explore the wide world. This game-course starts with easy and fundamental wilderness survival tasks and slowly gets you accustomed to living in the wild, eventually bringing you among people and ways of more settled life.
entries.translation: Tehtäviä erätaidon perusteiden opetteluun ja selviytymistaitojesi koettelemiseen maata kulkiessasi ja laajaa maailmaa tutkiessasi. Tämä pelikurssi alkaa helpoista erätaidon perustehtävistä ja totuttaa sinut vähitellen luonnossa elämiseen. Lopulta se vie sinut ihmisten pariin ja vakiintuneemman elämän tapoihin.

entries.source:
Point and click, or use cursor keys and [ENTER] to change values of setup options.
For advanced configuration options edit urw_ini.txt in your installation folder:
entries.translation:
Osoita ja napsauta tai muuta asetusten arvoja nuolinäppäimillä ja [ENTER]-näppäimellä.
Muuta lisäasetuksia muokkaamalla asennuskansion urw_ini.txt-tiedostoa:

entries.source: Maximum improvement allowed is 1 step(s) above the initial level.
entries.translation: Suurin sallittu parannus on 1 askel alkutasosta.

entries.source: Free gameplay - everything is up to you. You have no tasks or duties except the ones you decide to do or try out by yourself. This is the ultimate way of gaming for experienced, freedom desiring players - but suitable also for rookies to get to know the game mechanics first before trying task based game-courses.
entries.translation: Vapaa peli: kaikki on sinun päätettävissäsi. Sinulla ei ole muita tehtäviä tai velvollisuuksia kuin ne, jotka itse päätät tehdä tai kokeilla. Tämä on paras pelitapa kokeneille vapautta kaipaaville pelaajille, mutta sopii myös aloittelijoille pelin toimintaan tutustumiseen ennen tehtäväpohjaisten pelikurssien kokeilua.

entries.source: Varying tasks from more advanced wilderness survival and hunting techniques to encounters with the Unreal World as a whole; the regions near and far, the people of familiar cultures and far-away countries, the spirit world and more deeply entering into the living and making your livelihood in the far north. This is a game-course for more experienced players.
entries.translation: Vaihtelevia tehtäviä edistyneestä erätaidosta ja metsästyskeinoista UnReal Worldin kokonaisuuden kohtaamiseen: lähi- ja kaukoseutuihin, tuttujen kansojen ja kaukaisten maiden ihmisiin, henkimaailmaan sekä pohjolan elämään ja elannon hankintaan syventymiseen. Tämä pelikurssi on kokeneemmille pelaajille.

entries.source: You can choose to play a tutorial like game-course, or have completely freeform adventures in UnReal World. Game courses give you different kind of tasks and duties to perform. As you advance you'll be rewarded with bonus features and additions that are unique for each game course.
entries.translation: Voit pelata opastavaa pelikurssia tai seikkailla UnReal Worldissa täysin vapaasti. Pelikurssit antavat erilaisia tehtäviä ja velvollisuuksia. Edetessäsi saat palkkioksi kullekin kurssille ominaisia lisäominaisuuksia ja mahdollisuuksia.

entries.source: The story below is a description of your start-up scenario and a rough background of your character. You may find it interesting to follow or you can just ignore it. It only tells you what brought your character here - the rest is up to you. There are so many paths to follow, so many scenes to see, so many windbreezes to feel and ever so many secrets to find from the world around or within you...
entries.translation: Seuraava tarina kuvaa alkutilannettasi ja hahmosi taustaa pääpiirteissään. Voit seurata sitä kiinnostuneena tai sivuuttaa sen. Se kertoo vain, mikä toi hahmosi tänne. Loput päätät sinä. Niin monta polkua kuljettavaksi, niin monta näkymää nähtäväksi, niin monta tuulenhenkäystä tunnettavaksi ja yhä niin monta salaisuutta löydettäväksi ympäröivästä maailmasta tai omasta itsestäsi...

entries.source: First of all you must now secure your source of livelihood and gather yourself something to eat for the next few days. Check out your inventory to see what you already carry and fill your supplies the way you want: use your fishing skill, or tracking skill to track down and hunt animals, or if it's a suitable time of the year zoom into the terrain to gather berries or mushrooms. Or trade food from the people you meet if that's what suits you best. When you think you have enough food for at least five days eat something - and if you have plenty of food, the task is completed and you are ready to move on.
entries.translation: Ensiksi sinun pitää turvata elantosi ja hankkia syötävää muutamaksi päiväksi. Katso tavaraluettelosta, mitä jo kannat, ja täydennä varastoasi haluamallasi tavalla. Käytä kalastustaitoa tai jäljitä ja metsästä eläimiä. Sopivaan vuodenaikaan voit siirtyä lähimaastoon keräämään marjoja tai sieniä. Voit myös vaihtaa ruokaa kohtaamiltasi ihmisiltä, jos se sopii sinulle parhaiten. Kun arvelet ruoan riittävän ainakin viideksi päiväksi, syö jotakin. Jos ruokaa on tarpeeksi, tehtävä täyttyy ja olet valmis jatkamaan.

entries.source: There are several ways to accomplish each task. Sometimes you need to find a proper place or get specific equipment before it's even possible to accomplish the task. Therefore you should be aware of the possibilities the game has got to offer. Use your creativity and find alternative ways to get the tasks done. Sometimes it may take some time before circumstances are correct for the task to be done. Some extra work and patience will be also needed regularly. But as you advance - you will be rewarded...
entries.translation: Jokaisen tehtävän voi suorittaa monin tavoin. Joskus pitää ensin löytää sopiva paikka tai hankkia tietyt varusteet, ennen kuin tehtävä on edes mahdollinen. Siksi sinun kannattaa tuntea pelin tarjoamat mahdollisuudet. Käytä luovuuttasi ja etsi vaihtoehtoisia tapoja tehtävien täyttämiseen. Joskus sopivia olosuhteita joutuu odottamaan. Myös lisätyötä ja kärsivällisyyttä tarvitaan usein. Mutta edetessäsi saat palkkion...

entries.source:
You are about to enter The UnReal World for the first time with this character. When the game starts press [ESC] to view keyboard commands and help. From there on you may start to learn the secrets of the game.

This game encyclopedia can be started anytime by pressing [F1]. You are also notified during game-play when there's more information available about a topic.

The world beyond the game is rich and deeper than it first seems. Exploring and browsing the game encyclopedia may greatly stimulate your imagination and give greater texture and depth to the game. You'll also find answers to most of the questions about The UnReal World and the game here.

Feel free to browse the game information now, or press [ESC] to exit and start playing. We'll start with the myth of The Unreal World. You can go to main topics anytime by pressing [HOME].
entries.translation:
Olet astumassa UnReal Worldiin ensimmäistä kertaa tällä hahmolla. Pelin alettua paina [ESC] nähdäksesi näppäinkomennot ja ohjeet. Siitä voit aloittaa pelin salaisuuksien opettelun.

Tämän pelitietosanakirjan voi avata milloin tahansa painamalla [F1]. Saat pelin aikana myös ilmoituksen, kun aiheesta on lisätietoa.

Pelin taustalla oleva maailma on rikas ja syvempi kuin ensin näyttää. Tietosanakirjan tutkiminen ja selaaminen voi ruokkia mielikuvitustasi ja antaa peliin lisää sävyjä ja syvyyttä. Täältä löydät myös vastaukset useimpiin UnReal Worldia ja peliä koskeviin kysymyksiin.

Selaa rauhassa pelitietoja nyt tai paina [ESC] poistuaksesi ja aloittaaksesi pelin. Aloitamme UnReal Worldin myytistä. Pääaiheisiin pääset milloin tahansa painamalla [HOME].

entries.source:
For as long as you can remember you had been eager to take part in the hunting trips that the men of your home village regularly made. One day you were old enough to do so, and eagerly awaited the departure of the hunting party.
You left with your father and a few other hunters and travelled further and further away as the game you were tracking didn't seem to follow their usual annual course.
After a week your father decided to take you back home, and satisfied that you had managed to get few good kills, you agreed. The rest of the men continued the trip.
You and your father had been heading back home for two days when you found a fresh half eaten elk carcass. Unwilling to encounter the beast you changed your course a bit but didn't get very far as your father, walking before you, stopped. "Wait... I heard something", he said. You knelt down, heart throbbing, and watched as your father silently sneaked ahead and finally disappeared behind a big tree.
The forest was very silent for a moment, then a cry of your father was mixed with the sound of an attacking beast. You jumped to your feet and started to run towards the noise...
You found your father lying on the ground and bleeding badly. "Son... you must go... it's a...", your father whispered - then he was gone.

(Selecting this scenario gives you immediate fighting experience. If you manage to kill the beast or even escape from it you are on your own in the middle of the wide, unfamiliar environment. The equipment of your late father may become very useful to you if you manage to pick them up - and that way even though you are alone in the world now, your family will be with you.)
entries.translation:
Niin kauan kuin muistat, olet halunnut mukaan kotikyläsi miesten tavallisille metsästysretkille. Eräänä päivänä olit tarpeeksi vanha lähtemään ja odotit innolla metsästysseurueen lähtöä.
Lähdit isäsi ja muutaman muun metsästäjän kanssa. Kuljitte yhä kauemmas, sillä seuraamanne riista ei näyttänyt noudattavan tavanomaista vuotuista reittiään.
Viikon kuluttua isäsi päätti viedä sinut kotiin. Olit tyytyväinen muutamaan hyvään kaatoon ja suostuit. Muut miehet jatkoivat matkaa.
Olitte olleet kotimatkalla kaksi päivää, kun löysitte tuoreen puoliksi syödyn hirvenruhon. Ette halunneet kohdata petoa, joten muutitte hieman reittiänne. Ette ehtineet kauas, kun edelläsi kulkenut isäsi pysähtyi. "Odota... kuulin jotakin", hän sanoi. Polvistuit sydän jyskyttäen ja katsoit, kuinka isäsi hiipi hiljaa eteenpäin ja katosi lopulta suuren puun taakse.
Metsä oli hetken hyvin hiljainen. Sitten isäsi huuto sekoittui hyökkäävän pedon ääneen. Hyppäsit jaloillesi ja juoksit ääntä kohti...
Löysit isäsi maasta pahasti vertavuotavana. "Poika... sinun täytyy mennä... se on...", isäsi kuiskasi. Sitten hän oli poissa.

(Tämä alkutilanne antaa heti taistelukokemusta. Jos onnistut tappamaan pedon tai edes pakenemaan sitä, jäät yksin keskelle laajaa vierasta ympäristöä. Vainajan varusteista voi olla paljon hyötyä, jos onnistut poimimaan ne. Siten perheesi kulkee mukanasi, vaikka olet nyt yksin maailmassa.)

entries.source: Use numpad or cursor keys to move as described above. UrW movement system may feel tricky at first, but after a while you get used to it. The darkened movement commands are rarely needed. You may also switch to traditional roguelike movement in setup options.

At the age of sixteen you've left your home and village. During your childhood and adolescent years you have learnt the skills and ways of your people until you decided it was time for you to go search for a path of your own, whatever it might be.
One day a small party of men from your village were about to go on trading journey to some far away tribes. They promised to lead you to the village that was on their way if so wished, from where it would be more safe for you to start living on your own.
And so it was. The party left you standing outside the village as they continued on their way. Houses in the village seemed very cosy after the long trip but about the people you weren't too sure. You knew that you hadn't come here just to settle down again, but it would probably be a good idea to see what the village had to offer before rushing ahead.

(Starting at the village provides a safe way to start playing. You may equip your character carefully before going out to the wilderness and have a safe place to return to if you face setbacks or dangers on your journeys.)
entries.translation:
Olet kuusitoistavuotiaana lähtenyt kodistasi ja kylästäsi. Lapsuutesi ja nuoruutesi aikana opit kansasi taidot ja tavat, kunnes päätit lähteä etsimään omaa polkuasi, mikä se sitten olisikaan.
Eräänä päivänä pieni joukko kyläsi miehiä oli lähdössä kauppamatkalle kaukaisten heimojen luo. He lupasivat halutessasi saattaa sinut matkansa varrella olevaan kylään, josta sinun olisi turvallisempaa aloittaa itsenäinen elämä.
Niin myös kävi. Seurue jätti sinut seisomaan kylän ulkopuolelle ja jatkoi matkaansa. Talot näyttivät pitkän matkan jälkeen hyvin kodikkailta, mutta väestä et ollut yhtä varma. Tiesit, ettet ollut tullut tänne vain asettuaksesi jälleen aloillesi, mutta kylän tarjontaan olisi ehkä hyvä tutustua ennen kiirehtimistä eteenpäin.

(Kylästä aloittaminen on turvallinen tapa aloittaa peli. Voit varustaa hahmosi huolellisesti ennen erämaahan lähtöä, ja sinulla on turvallinen paluupaikka, jos kohtaat retkilläsi vastoinkäymisiä tai vaaroja.)

entries.translation: Se on puolen päivän kävelymatkan päässä.

entries.source: Sorry, stranger. I've got nothing to trade.
entries.translation: Pahoittelut, muukalainen. Minulla ei ole mitään vaihdettavaa.

entries.source: If you like the goods around here, just pick up the ones you need and come talk to me about trading for them.
entries.translation: Jos pidät tavaroistamme, poimi tarvitsemasi ja tule puhumaan niiden vaihtamisesta.

entries.source: !There is nothing here to pick up.
!You hear someone shouting: "Don't you dare to leave with unpaid goods!"
entries.translation: !Kuulet jonkun huutavan: "Älä uskallakaan lähteä maksamattomien tavaroiden kanssa!"

entries.source: You hear a black grouse cooing in the north-west.
!You've been attacked from out of sight!
He lands a solid hit to your eye.
entries.translation: Hän saa kunnon osuman vastustajan silmään.

entries.source: :The world turns black and you fall unconscious.
#HELP AND GAME OPTIONS: Quit and optionally save
entries.translation: #OHJEET JA PELIASETUKSET: Lopeta ja tallenna halutessasi

entries.source: The remains of your earthly body leaves behind as your spirit starts its journey to the otherworld - the place where the dead live.
entries.translation: Maallisen ruumiisi jäännökset jäävät taakse, kun henkesi lähtee matkalle tuonpuoleiseen, vainajien asuinsijoille.

entries.source: Free gameplay - everything is up to you. You have no tasks or duties except the ones you decide to do or try out by yourself. This is the ultimate way of gaming for experienced, freedom desiring players - but suitable also for rookies to get to know the game mechanics first before trying task based game-courses.
entries.translation: Vapaa peli: kaikki on sinun päätettävissäsi. Sinulla ei ole muita tehtäviä tai velvollisuuksia kuin ne, jotka itse päätät tehdä tai kokeilla. Tämä on paras pelitapa kokeneille vapautta kaipaaville pelaajille, mutta sopii myös aloittelijoille pelin toimintaan tutustumiseen ennen tehtäväpohjaisten pelikurssien kokeilua.

parts: Tasks to teach you the basics of wilderness survival and to test your survival skills as you
roam across the land and explore the wide world. This game-course starts with easy and fundamental wilderness survival
tasks and slowly gets you accustomed to living in the wild, eventually bringing you among people and ways of more settled life.

entries.source: Tasks to teach you the basics of wilderness survival and to test your survival skills as you roam across the land and explore the wide world. This game-course starts with easy and fundamental wilderness survival tasks and slowly gets you accustomed to living in the wild, eventually bringing you among people and ways of more settled life.
entries.translation: Tehtäviä erätaidon perusteiden opetteluun ja selviytymistaitojesi koettelemiseen maata kulkiessasi ja laajaa maailmaa tutkiessasi. Tämä pelikurssi alkaa helpoista erätaidon perustehtävistä ja totuttaa sinut vähitellen luonnossa elämiseen. Lopulta se vie sinut ihmisten pariin ja vakiintuneemman elämän tapoihin.

parts: Varying tasks from more advanced wilderness survival and hunting techniques to encounters with the Unreal World as a whole; the regions near and far,
the people of familiar cultures and far-away countries, the spirit world and more deeply entering into the living and making your livelihood in the far north.
This is a game-course for more experienced players.

entries.translation: Vaihtelevia tehtäviä edistyneestä erätaidosta ja metsästyskeinoista UnReal Worldin kokonaisuuden kohtaamiseen: lähi- ja kaukoseutuihin, tuttujen kansojen ja kaukaisten maiden ihmisiin, henkimaailmaan sekä pohjolan elämään ja elannon hankintaan syventymiseen. Tämä pelikurssi on kokeneemmille pelaajille.

entries.source: There are several ways to accomplish each task. Sometimes you need to find a proper place or get specific equipment before it's even possible to accomplish the task. you can take a look and examine it if it's within your field of vision.

entries.translation: Vesi on välttämätöntä. Tutki ympäristöä, kunnes löydät makean veden lähteen, kuten järven tai lammen. Ota sitten suuri kulaus raikasta vettä ja jatka uusin voimin. Talvella se ei käy yhtä helposti: sinun pitää tehdä avanto kalastustaidolla. Jos mietit, mitä jossakin paikassa on, voit katsoa ja tutkia sitä, kunhan se on näkökentässäsi.

as well. You may want to look in a given direction or investigate the location you are at more closely to see what's around you.

copies.source: To survive in the wilderness, especially in the winter, you need to learn how to make a fire. That's your next task. You can find and pick up several branches and drop them
where you wish to build a fire, use your timbercraft skill to cut branches from a tree, or you can even set fire to a dry fallen tree. To place heavy trunks or a pile of firewood
to a location where you wish to build a fire you can use the push items-command. Finally, use start a fire command to light up the firewood.

copies.source: As you probably will need to fish and hunt for your livelihood, you also need to learn to cook what you catch or kill. Now use your cookery skill to prepare some food. The most
simple recipe is just to roast raw fish or meat over the campfire. While the food is being cooked and if you don't have anything else to do, you can use the wait or rest commands
to kill some time. Your nose will tell you when the food is ready so be ready to cancel your lazy time or you will burn the food.

list faster.

copies.source: Next you need to try out fishing, a good and relatively easy way to keep yourself fed. You can fish with a fishing rod, a spear or even a club. These are active fishing methods. You
can fish passively by using nets. Now find a suitable body of water, like a lake or river, and use your fishing skill. Before going fishing you may want to eat some food if you have
any as it's more comfortable to wait for a catch on a full stomach.

copies.source: Man is not the only being roaming The Unreal World; there are also wide variety of animals which you can't avoid encountering from time to time, and which you need to learn to hunt down
or defend yourself against. Your task now is to wander until you encounter an animal in the wilderness. You may wander around the wilderness map and try out your tracking skill here and
there. With skill, luck and patience you may be able to track down an animal, but bumping unexpectedly into wildlife while walking through the wilderness is also common. People also
sometimes share news about sightings, especially of bigger animals. If your expedition takes you far away, refer to your map of known areas to find your way in the world.

copies.source: Now you need to hunt down and kill an animal. If the animal you have encountered is too challenging for you, back away and go track down something else, and this time make sure you are
properly prepared and equipped for the encounter. Sometimes you may need to hide and sneak (stalk) so as not to alarm a dangerous or skittish animal. Sometimes a quick rush and some running
after escaping prey is required. It's up to you whether you choose close combat or ranged weapons such as a bow and arrow to bring down the animal.

copies.source: You can use the skins of the animals you've hunted to make clothes or to trade away, especially if it's a valuable fur. However, the fresh skin needs to be tanned before it's useable
as fur or leather, and that is your next task. First use your hideworking skill to skin the carcass. After this you may want to cut up the carcass for the meat and fat. When you have
the fresh hide in your inventory, use your hideworking skill again to tan the skin; you'll need either the animal fat or some bark and some water during the process.

copies.source: Rafts and punts are watercrafts used for traveling on the water. Sestas and paddles are used to pole or row them ahead. Your next task is to get yourself a watercraft of some kind and a sesta
or a paddle - then row across a lake. Notice that you can make a raft, a sesta and a paddle yourself. It's a good idea to find a lake before starting to make a raft. When you have obtained or
made a watercraft, place it on the shore, step in and wield a sesta or a paddle to move your watercraft. If you do contruct a raft further from the shore you can use move items-command to drag it
by the water.

copies.source: Even if you can survive on your own it's useful to know where you can find other people. Your next task is to find a village or settlement and enter it to see what it can offer you. There
is a vast wilderness and villages are rather rare, so you may want to equip yourself carefully for this expedition. When you are ready start roaming across the wilderness map. Settlements
usually tend to be near water and watercourses. Checking cultural regions from the map of known areas helps you to know when you are wandering in an inhabitated region. If you encounter some
wandering people you can talk to them and ask for directions to the nearest village.

copies.source: At some point you may want to settle down more properly and build your own house. Your next task is to get a feeling for this. Now find a place where you would like to live for some time - feel
free to travel further from the populated areas or select a cultural territory where you feel at home - and start constructing a house of your own. It all starts by felling trees and carving
them into logs with your timbercraft skill. When you have the required materials construct a section of wall to get started.
Logs are heavy to carry, but you can easily move a pile of them by your building site using the move items-command.

copies.source: In addition to hunting, fishing and gathering berries etc. agriculture is a source of independent livelihood which you need to try out now by planting something. You can spend some time looking
for a nice place for your field and then use your agriculture skill to first prepare the soil and then plant some seeds or vegetables. Remember that the ground needs to be fertilized first by
burning some wood, but you will be reminded of this when using the agriculture skill.

copies.source: From many villages you can trade the items you've found or made to obtain your own animals. Animals are very useful as pack animals to carry loads and some of them can be milked. Use extended
commands to milk an animal. To pack the animal you have, use push items command to its direction. For unpacking your pack animal, use picking up items from a direction.
Having livestock also naturally secures your source of fresh meat. Your next task is to get yourself an animal, either from a village or by leashing a tame animal
you may occasionally encounter. Leash an animal by applying a rope to it. Talk to villagers for animal trading possibilities.

yourself a companion for a short journey. Find some people and talk to them asking them to join you by selecting the "Ask for help" chat option. Besides of hiring people only to hunt
or go adventuring with you, they can help you in your daily life - for example if you need some extra hand at your building site.

copies.source: Various traps are used in passive hunting to catch different animals. Your task now is to try this out and set a trap anywhere you like. You must zoom into the local terrain, set a trap
either with the apply command if you have a single item trap, or by using the TRAPPING skill to make one of the various trap constructions by yourself. After the trap is set zoom back out
to the wilderness map. You can freely decide the trap location and form based on what kind of animals you want to catch. If you are after carnivores, baiting the trap after it has been
set is required to make it effective at all.

copies.source: You can view cultural regions from the map of known areas. Your task now is to pick up your things and travel to any area that doesn't belong to any
cultural region (appears in black color). Check out your destination first and equip yourself properly for the expedition, maybe make yourself some items or tools you might find necessary.
On your journey you may need to fill in supplies, so feel free to try out your tracking and fishing skills for example. And feel free to explore
villages or interact with people if they come in your way. When you've reached the no man's land, settle down and use your building skill to make a shelter.

copies.source: You can find signs of wandering animals by using your tracking skill, and that is your next task. Tracks are easiest to find on the zoomed-in maps as they are shown graphically, but the
skill can also be used on the zoomed out wilderness map. You will probably need to search for tracks in several places to find a trail, unless an animal is encountered face to face and
a visible trail is spotted. Not all animals will leave tracks on any surface, except in the wintertime and on fresh snow. Reading the in game info about tracking is recommended, as there are
many factors involved. If it seems to take a long time to locate some tracks there's no need to rush. Keep yourself fed, take a break and continue the next day.

copies.source: Now you need to catch some fish, by using any fishing technique you want. If you are lacking fishing equipment you need to go find yourself some first. Spears and clubs
can be used to catch pike from shallow waters but that's not too common - especially if you aren't a skilled fisherman. The islanders and the people of the Driik surely
possess some fishing equipment if you wish to to take this task seriously, but even a little perch from a lake nearby will be counted as a catch. So check out, make or
trade your fishing equipment, go by the water and then use your fishing skill. The map of known areas reveals the waters nearby if you have visited them already.

fishing ability to catch one. To make your fishing succesful you need to go further from the river bank, so a watercraft like a punt or a raft will be necessary.
A good salmon river may also require some exploring, the best ones are said to be found in the north.

copies.source: In the north of The Unreal World, and occasionally inland, you can find mountains. And in the mountains there are sometimes caves. Caves can provide a shelter for an adventurer during
a rainy night, but they can also be a lynx or bear den. Your next task is to find a cave and explore it to see what's inside. You can ask directions from any people you meet, but boldly
heading to northern regions will surely bring some mountains into view - but remember that not every mountain has a cave. Since the caves are dark, find or make some torches first. To
light a torch you need to apply it to a burning campfire.

copies.source: A bow can be a very efficient weapon in hunting and in combat. Your task now is to practice archery and improve your skills as a bowman. Find or make yourself a bow and practice your archery
with a live target. This can take some time but eventually, and especially after skilled shots, you will improve - as with every skill you use. You may want to spend some time making arrows
also since they do break sometimes. To shoot with a bow, have it wielded and use throw command to shoot an arrow. When you have some decent archery equipment, go bowhunting and don't expect
to see results before days, sometimes even weeks, of shooting practice.

copies.source: Njerpez warriors, foreigners from the east, have been making raids in this region. Your next task is to find their camp and kill all of them. When you find the camp you can make plans for
how and when to attack them. You'd better be prepared and properly armed too. Wandering Njerpez warriors are encountered from time to time, but in the wilderness the conflicts are easier to
avoid. In their camp you can expect to find numerous warriors so hiding and sneaking could be a very useful tactic.

copies.source: Trap-fences are effective especially for catching big animals that move in herds, for example wild reindeers. Your task now is to build a trap-fence of your own. Find a good place, zoom into
the terrain and start building the fence, and maybe read the hunting and fences section of the game-info browser for more information that can be useful. The shape of the fence is up to you,
but the idea here is to make a fence that an animal will start to follow and leave an opening here and there. In the openings you need to dig pits by using a shovel. When your fence is ready,
turn pits into a trap-pits and zoom back out to the wilderness map to finish the task. The fence needs to be rather long to be effective.

copies.source: Your clothes wear out as time goes by so you'll need to get or make new clothes eventually. You can make some clothes by yourself and that's your next task: to make yourself some fur clothing.
A hunter wearing a wolf or bear fur cloak for example is an impressive sight, but any fur and piece of clothing will do for now. To get fur you first need to find and kill a fur-bearing animal
(a fox, hare, glutton, or bear for example) and then use your hideworking skill to skin the animal and to tan the skin. After the skin is tanned you can make clothing out of it. Naturally the
bigger the cloth the more fur you will need, but smaller pieces of fur can be used to complete an item if you have enough of them to put together.

copies.source: First of all you must now secure your source of livelihood and gather yourself something to eat for the next few days. Check out your inventory to see what you already carry and fill your
supplies the way you want: use your fishing skill, or tracking skill to track down and hunt animals, or if it's a suitable time of the year zoom into the terrain to gather berries or mushrooms.
Or trade food from the people you meet if that's what suits you best. When you think you have enough food for at least five days eat something - and if you have plenty of food, the task is
completed and you are ready to move on.

copies.source: The northern people are well known for their unique supernatural powers and sorcery. It is commonly held that they can drive supernatural powers into the weapons they make, especially knives
and bows. And with no doubt northern knives and bows are strong and effective weapons, with or without the use of sorcery. Your next task is to obtain a northern bow or a northern knife. Travel
to the northern reaches of the world, and find someone willing to trade you one of these items. Then, get a feeling for your new and unique piece of northern weaponry by wielding it.

copies.source: Salt is rare, valuable, and very useful. Salt production generally takes place on an archipelago. Driik and the regions of the Islanders are the main areas where you can obtain salt.
Salt is rarely found inland, but may be brought in by foreign traders and tradesmen of the inland. Your task is to travel to an archipelago of The Unreal World to find and trade for
some bags of salt. Remember that you need to get the salt
by trading, and only by trading. Be sure to bring something along that you can trade for the salt.

copies.source: Your next task is to build yourself a house - a complete house. So don't rush! Find a territory and terrain which suits you. You want a place that you can call home for some time.
You can also build yourself a hunting cottage somewhere. The shape and size of the house is up you, as is its usage. The task isn't complete until your house has all the walls up
and you've started working on ceiling and floor. Be sure to equip yourself with the proper axes - like having a carving axe and broad axe for making logs and log walls properly.
Move items-command is very useful when working with heavy lumber and organizing your piles of raw material like boards etc.
