actual missile strike may vary from a mere scratch to an impact of full force - or in some cases, it could also
be a narrow miss.

The smaller the target, the more accurate shot/throw you need to actually hit it. For man-sized targets
even the poorest final accuracy always results to a strike of some degree, but anything smaller needs that 
much more precision. If the final hit accuracy isn't good enough compared to target size the missile won't
hit at all.

A target that is being attacked by a missile weapon can't choose any conscious defense maneuver as in
melee combat, but moving targets can still avoid getting hit. This defense possibility for moving targets is
automated and it doesn't matter if the target is aware of the attack or not. A target is considered 
moving if it is actively running, flying, escaping etc. from one location to another, but also when it's
making fast movements in its place like when engaged in a fight. The faster the target is moving the better chance
it has to make it out of the way or to make a lucky movement in its place and unintentionally dodge the missile.
This is based on the target's actual mobility and manner of moving, so if the target is slowed down due to physical
penalties or for whatever reason, its chances to avoid missile attacks are lowered accordingly. Naturally, it's not
only the target's speed that matters but the missile velocity as well. It's easier for any moving target to make
it out of the way of low-velocity missiles, but very fast animals will be challenging to hit even with bow and
arrow - and exceedingly challenging if they are both fast and small.
entries.translation:
Etäaseen kohteella tarkoitetaan elävää kohdetta, johon hyökätään etäaseella.

Osumisen jälkeenkin kohteen koko, toiminta ja lopullinen osumatarkkuus voivat vaikuttaa laukauksen tai heiton todelliseen tulokseen riippumatta siitä, oliko osuma tarkoitettu vai vahinko. Käytännössä vakaa laukaus tai heitto osuu harvoin aivan tähtäyspisteen keskelle, vaan poikkeaa siitä yleensä hieman. Lopullisen osumatarkkuuden määrää se, kuinka kaukana ammus on tarkoitetusta kohdasta saapuessaan osumapaikalle. Sen mukaan osuma voi vaihdella pelkästä naarmusta täysivoimaiseen iskuun tai joskus täpärään ohilaukaukseen.

Mitä pienempi kohde, sitä tarkempi laukaus tai heitto tarvitaan. Ihmisen kokoiseen kohteeseen heikoinkin lopullinen tarkkuus tuottaa jonkinlaisen osuman, mutta pienemmät kohteet vaativat vastaavasti enemmän tarkkuutta. Jos se ei riitä kohteen kokoon nähden, ammus menee kokonaan ohi.

Etäaseella ahdistettu kohde ei voi valita tietoista puolustusliikettä kuten lähitaistelussa, mutta liikkuva kohde voi silti välttää osuman. Tämä mahdollisuus toteutuu automaattisesti, eikä sillä ole merkitystä, tietääkö kohde hyökkäyksestä. Liikkeeksi lasketaan juokseminen, lentäminen, pakeneminen ja muu siirtyminen paikasta toiseen sekä nopeat liikkeet paikallaan, esimerkiksi taistelussa. Mitä nopeammin kohde liikkuu, sitä todennäköisemmin se ehtii pois tieltä tai tekee onnekkaan liikkeen ja väistää ammuksen tahattomasti. Tämä perustuu kohteen todelliseen liikkuvuuteen ja liikkumistapaan. Ruumiillisten haittojen tai muiden syiden hidastaman kohteen väistämismahdollisuudet heikkenevät vastaavasti. Myös ammuksen nopeus vaikuttaa: hidasta ammusta on liikkuvan kohteen helpompi väistää. Erittäin nopeisiin eläimiin on silti vaikea osua jousellakin, ja erityisen vaikeaa se on, jos eläin on sekä nopea että pieni.

// upd 7-sep-2014

entries.source:
Bow is a missile combat weapon usually made of wood and used to propel an arrow. There are different bow types and designs varying in size, shape and strength:
SPRUCE QUICK-BOW, SHORTBOW, LONGBOW, NORTHERN BOW and HUNTING BOW.

In addition to these regular bows there are also crossbows which are mostly of foreign origin.
See also: BOWSTRING

Every bow needs to be strung with a proper bowstring before it can be used to shoot arrows.
Bowstrings wear out in use and thus need to be replaced every now and then. The lower the quality, the faster the bowstring is prone to breaking. A good quality bowstring can last up to roughly a thousand shots.
When the bowstring breaks, a message is displayed and the bow gets described as a "bow with no string". You can add a new bowstring to a bow with no string with the [a]pply command. First apply the bowstring, and then select a bow to be strung with the string.
Proper bowstrings are made out of multiple strands of yarn twisted together, but you could also use thin cordage for a makeshift bowstring. Upon crafting a bowstring you can select the material to be used, either yarn or cord. It's faster to make a bowstring from a cord and the required length is also far shorter, but bowstrings made out of cords are also always of lesser quality.
entries.translation:
Jokainen jousi täytyy jännittää kunnollisella jänteellä ennen nuolten ampumista.
Jänne kuluu käytössä ja on siksi vaihdettava aika ajoin. Mitä huonompi laatu, sitä herkemmin jänne katkeaa. Hyvälaatuinen jänne voi kestää noin tuhat laukausta.
Jänteen katketessa peli ilmoittaa siitä, ja jousen kuvaukseksi tulee "jousi ilman jännettä". Voit asentaa uuden jänteen komennolla [a]. Käytä ensin jännettä ja valitse sitten jousi, johon se kiinnitetään.
Kunnolliset jousenjänteet tehdään useista yhteen kierretyistä langoista, mutta ohut nyöri käy hätävarajänteeksi. Valmistettaessa voit valita materiaaliksi lankaa tai nyöriä. Nyöristä jänne syntyy nopeammin ja vaatii paljon lyhyemmän materiaalin, mutta nyörijänteet ovat aina huonolaatuisempia.
// upd 23-aug-2021

entries.source:
Spruce quick-bow is the most simple and quick to make type of a bow. It's made out of a single branch that is cut from a standing spruce tree. After the small side branches are cut away and the quick-bow is practically ready to be strung, although sometimes quick tillering is needed. It goes without saying that this type of bow is not a high performance weapon, but it is efficient enough for hunting squirrels and other small game.
Northern peoples sometimes go hunting small game carrying only arrows and a bowstring with them and then craft a spruce quick-bow only if need be.

Spells are both a way to communicate with the otherworldly beings such as spirits, and to affect to the mundane environment with magical means. There are spells to seek favour in hunting and fishing, sacrificies to keep the nature spirits pleased, means to follow in order to assure ones livelihood, and so on. The ways how the unseen can affect the tangible world are numerous and varied.

Spells should be respected and not performed without a proper reason. Spirits of nature are always present and your deeds will be noticed by them. As the spells get you in contact with the otherworld it should be understood not to disturb the spirits needlessly, nor to take advantage of their generosity or favourableness. Sometimes it will be clearly notified if the spirits like you or not. And if it's the latter case it might be worthwhile to try remedy the situation with a right spell or a sacrifice.

Every character knows some spells to start with and may learn more during their life. Key-command [F4] shows the list of known spells, along with their descriptions. Merely selecting a spell from the list doesn't make the magic happen. To perform a spell read the spell description and follow the instructions by using the ordinary game mechanics. For example, if the spell instructions would say "throw three rocks at a spruce tree before the sunrise and your loop snares will be favourable" the spell would be performed by actually throwing three rocks at a spruce tree before the sunrise.

Some spells are simple, some are more complex, but most often they consists of seemingly ordinary things that have underlying magical meaning once you know it. Effects of the spells often seem vague and subtle. There rarely are evident results to be noticed, but nevertheless the magical, ritualistic and mythical actions learned and performed do have impact on the unreal world.

Spells are strongly linked to the cultural mythology so you should learn about that too.
entries.translation:
Loitsut ovat keino pitää yhteyttä tuonpuoleisiin olentoihin, kuten henkiin, ja vaikuttaa arkiseen ympäristöön taikuudella. On loitsuja metsästys- ja kalaonnen parantamiseen, uhreja luonnonhenkien miellyttämiseen ja elannon turvaavia toimintatapoja. Näkymätön voi vaikuttaa aineelliseen maailmaan monin eri tavoin.

Loitsuja tulee kunnioittaa eikä niitä pidä tehdä ilman hyvää syytä. Luonnonhenget ovat aina läsnä ja huomaavat tekosi. Koska loitsu yhdistää sinut tuonpuoleiseen, henkiä ei tule häiritä turhaan eikä niiden anteliaisuutta tai suosiollisuutta käyttää hyväksi. Joskus saat selvän merkin siitä, pitävätkö henget sinusta. Jos eivät pidä, tilannetta kannattaa yrittää korjata sopivalla loitsulla tai uhrilla.

Jokainen hahmo tuntee aluksi joitakin loitsuja ja voi oppia lisää elämänsä aikana. Näppäin [F4] näyttää tunnettujen loitsujen luettelon kuvauksineen. Pelkkä valinta luettelosta ei käynnistä taikuutta. Lue loitsun kuvaus ja toteuta sen ohjeet tavallisilla pelitoiminnoilla. Jos ohjeessa esimerkiksi käsketään heittämään kolme kiveä kuuseen ennen auringonnousua, jotta lanka-ansat olisivat suotuisia, loitsu tehdään todella heittämällä kolme kiveä kuuseen ennen auringonnousua.

Jotkin loitsut ovat yksinkertaisia, toiset monimutkaisempia. Useimmiten ne koostuvat näennäisen arkisista asioista, joiden taikamerkityksen ymmärrät tiedon saatuasi. Vaikutukset näyttävät usein epämääräisiltä ja hienovaraisilta. Selviä tuloksia havaitsee harvoin, mutta opitut ja toteutetut maagiset, rituaaliset ja myyttiset teot vaikuttavat silti UnReal Worldiin.

Loitsut liittyvät vahvasti kulttuurien mytologiaan, joten siihenkin kannattaa tutustua. // updated & proofred: 11-Sep-2011 //

entries.source:
Your character can get hurt several ways, but most often injuries result from combat and hunting situations.
There are a wide variety of possible injuries such as bruises, cuts and bites - resulting from a varying attacks
or causes - generated for specific body locations and having different levels of damage. In general all the injuries
lower the victim's physical performance according to their severity in a form of physical penalty.
There are additional effects that may result from bleeding wounds and limb injuries.

To improve healing of your injuries, use the physician skill for wound treatment.

The most severe of all injuries are the bleeding wounds. These will cause the victim to bleed to death unless treatment is given by means of the physician skill. There are different rates of bleeding wounds which will accumulate the bloodloss accordingly. The bloodloss meter shows your character's total bloodloss. When it reaches the maximum, based on your character's endurance, you will first pass out - and finally die. Thus it is of utmost importance to take care of bleeding wounds before loosing fatal amount blood.

Even after all the bleeding is succesfully stopped a threat to life may still exist as recovery from bloodloss is a lengthy process. Blood regeneration is a natural, automatic process and over time you will gain back the lost blood, but as complete recovery can take several days you may want to avoid spilling any more of your blood during the healing period.
entries.translation:
Vakavimpia vammoja ovat verta vuotavat haavat. Uhri vuotaa kuiviin, ellei häntä hoideta lääkintätaidolla. Vuodon voimakkuus vaihtelee, ja verenhukka kertyy sen mukaisesti. Verenhukkamittari näyttää hahmon menettämän veren kokonaismäärän. Kun kestävyydestä riippuva enimmäismäärä täyttyy, hahmo ensin menettää tajuntansa ja lopulta kuolee. Vuotavat haavat on siis hoidettava ennen kuin verta menetetään kohtalokkaasti.

Vaikka kaikki vuodot saadaan tyrehdytettyä, hengenvaara voi jatkua: verenhukasta toipuminen vie pitkään. Veri uusiutuu luonnostaan ja automaattisesti ajan kuluessa. Täysi toipuminen voi kuitenkin kestää useita päiviä, joten paranemisen aikana kannattaa välttää uusia verenmenetyksiä.

entries.source: This topic is under construction. Refer to injuries.

It is possible to self-treat your injuries by using the physician skill. The necessity and the method for wound 
treatment varies depending on the type of the injury. Minor wounds will usually heal by themselves, but grievous
wounds can develop serious effects or impair you for a long time unless properly treated.

Wounds can be treated on a daily basis for as long as the injury persists. There can be several different
treatments available for a single injury of which you can choose the ones to use - or the ones possible for you at 
the moment. Certain equipment and/or supplies, such as water or bandages, are often necessary. For almost every 
treatment it's also possible to use healing herbs in the process. For bleeding wounds the further treatment
is possible only after the bloodloss is halted.

The treatment result depends on your physician skill and quality and properties of the equipment and supplies 
used. A successful treatment will improve the healing of an injury and lower the risk of complications, but 
mistakes are also possible and can worsen the healing process. For serious wounds, however, some first-aid is always
recommended over no treatment at all. After that, it's up for your consideration whether you think you can do 
better for a specific wound today, or should it be wiser not touch it at all.

Any amount of injury to a limb will have its effects, but these are most dramatic
when a limb is injured so extensively that it becomes completely unusable. Sometimes even a single grievous injury 
can render the entire limb unusable, but this can also happen gradually from several lesser wounds. Limb injuries 
play a great role in combat situations and in hunting animals that would be impossible to catch by running 
unless their mobility is significantly slowed down. 

Leg injuries obviously affect the victim's ability to walk, run or stand up. Leg injuries always lower the
victim's mobility based on their severity, and if an entire leg becomes unusable the victim either falls prone or 
starts to limp seriously. Quadruped animals can stand up and walk as long as they have three usable legs, but the 
mobility of a limping animal is significantly lowered. For humans, an unusable legs means not being able to stand 
up and being able to move only by crawling. When an arm is injured to the extent of becoming unusable, any items 
held by it are dropped and wielding or handling items becomes impossible. The unusable limbs will gain back their 
functionality after the wounds have healed enough. This can be improved with proper wound treatment.
entries.translation:
Jokainen raajavamma vaikuttaa, mutta vaikutus on voimakkain raajan vahingoittuessa täysin käyttökelvottomaksi. Joskus yksi vakava vamma riittää tähän, mutta sama voi tapahtua vähitellen useiden pienempien haavojen seurauksena. Raajavammat ovat tärkeitä taistelussa ja metsästettäessä eläimiä, joita ei voisi juoksemalla tavoittaa ilman huomattavaa liikkuvuuden heikkenemistä.

Jalkavammat vaikuttavat kävelyyn, juoksemiseen ja pystyssä pysymiseen. Ne vähentävät liikkuvuutta aina vakavuutensa mukaan. Jos jalka muuttuu täysin käyttökelvottomaksi, uhri kaatuu tai alkaa ontua pahasti. Nelijalkainen eläin voi seistä ja kävellä, kun kolme jalkaa toimii, mutta ontuvan eläimen liikkuvuus heikkenee huomattavasti. Ihminen ei yhden jalan menetettyä toimintakykynsä voi seistä, vaan pystyy liikkumaan vain ryömimällä. Käden muuttuessa käyttökelvottomaksi siinä pidetyt esineet putoavat eikä sillä voi enää käyttää tai käsitellä esineitä. Raajat palautuvat käyttöön haavojen parannuttua riittävästi. Oikea haavanhoito edistää tätä.

entries.source:
Simply applying a cold compress to the wound.
Necessary equipment/supplies: WATER and BANDAGES.
entries.translation:
Haavalle asetetaan kylmä kääre.
Tarvittavat välineet ja tarvikkeet: WATER ja SITEET.

entries.source:
Cleaning and dressing the wound.
Necessary equipment/supplies: WATER and BANDAGES.
entries.translation:
Haavan puhdistaminen ja sitominen.
Tarvittavat välineet ja tarvikkeet: WATER ja SITEET.

entries.source:
To set and splint the bone you need some kind of a splint (usually
any stick, branch or even a spear will work) and BANDAGES.
entries.translation: Luun asettamiseen ja lastoittamiseen tarvitaan jonkinlainen lasta, yleensä keppi, oksa tai vaikka keihäs, sekä siteitä: SITEET.

entries.source:
Bandages are strips or slices of cloth, leather etc. used to tie
up wounds with the PHYSICIAN skill.

Your character knows many skills and the outcome and success of nearly every action is determined by some skill.

The skill mastery level affects to how well you manage to perform skill based activities. However, the effective mastery of skills is often impaired due to physical penalties your character may have.

Success of skill usage can be seen in time required to complete a task, quality of crafted items and so on. The effect of skill mastery is very significant, but it should be noted that a beginner can have some luck too and even an expert can make a mistake.

All the skills can be improved by using them and there's also a learning curve to it. The lower the skill mastery level is the faster the skill will raise upon succesful usage, even though you can sometimes learn from mistakes too. Skills also improve faster or slower according to how challenging or educational the performed task is. For example, you'll learn more about timbercraft by making boards than by chopping firewood.

Craft and lore skills:
AGRICULTURE, HERBLORE, FISHING, PHYSICIAN, TRACKING,
COOKERY, HIDEWORKING, CLOTHCRAFT, TIMBERCRAFT, WEATHERLORE,
TRAPPING, CARPENTRY, BUILDING, TEXTILECRAFT, NETMAKING, BOWYER

Physical skills:
CLIMBING, SWIMMING, SKIING, STEALTH

Combat skills:
WEAPON SKILLS, DODGE, UNARMED
entries.translation:
Hahmosi osaa monia taitoja, ja lähes kaikkien toimien tulos ja onnistuminen määräytyvät jonkin taidon perusteella.

Taitotaso vaikuttaa siihen, kuinka hyvin taitoa vaativat toimet onnistuvat. Hahmon ruumiilliset haitat kuitenkin usein heikentävät käytännön taitotasoa.

Onnistuminen näkyy esimerkiksi tehtävän kestossa ja valmistettujen esineiden laadussa. Taitotason vaikutus on suuri, mutta aloittelijallakin voi käydä onni ja asiantuntijakin voi erehtyä.

Kaikki taidot kehittyvät käyttämällä, ja kehitykseen kuuluu oppimiskäyrä. Mitä matalampi taitotaso, sitä nopeammin taito kasvaa onnistuneessa käytössä. Joskus virheistäkin oppii. Kehityksen nopeus riippuu myös tehtävän haastavuudesta ja opettavaisuudesta. Esimerkiksi lautojen tekeminen opettaa puunkäsittelyä enemmän kuin polttopuiden pilkkominen.

Käsityö- ja tietotaidot:
MAANVILJELY, KASVITIETO, KALASTUS, LÄÄKINTÄ, JÄLJITYS,
RUOANLAITTO, NAHANMUOKKAUS, VAATEOMPELU, PUUNKÄSITTELY, SÄÄTIETO,
ANSAPYYNTI, PUUSEPÄNTAITO, RAKENTAMINEN, TEKSTIILITYÖ, NETMAKING, BOWYER

Ruumiilliset taidot:
KIIPEILY, UINTI, HIIHTO, HIIVISKELY

Taistelutaidot:
ASETAIDOT, VÄISTÖ, ASEETON TAISTELU

// added & proofred 28-Feb-2012 //

entries.source:
Dodge refers to one of your characters's skills, and is also one of the defense maneuvers. 
As a skill, it determines your ability to dodge melee attacks. The initial level of dodging 
skill is based on your character's agility, but like any other skill, it can be improved by experience.

As a defense maneuver, dodging is an attempt to evade attacks by ducking, leaping, or otherwise
trying to get out of harm's way. Dodging is always a demanding feat of agility, and can result in 
stumbling or falling if performed clumsily. At its very best, a swift and graceful dodge 
not only saves the defender from getting struck, but may also grant him/her a tactical advantage. 
When an attempt to dodge is only partially succesful, the defender gets struck, but the force
of the attack is decreased accordingly.

Dodging is most effective against weapons with a short reach - this also covers unarmed attacks. 
When trying to dodge weapons with a good reach and high attack class dodging gets that much more challenging.

Dodge is an applicable defense maneuver only against melee attacks. When being attacked by means of 
missile combat, the factors determining the defender's chances to avoid the attack are calculated
differenty.
entries.translation:
Väistö tarkoittaa sekä hahmon taitoa että yhtä puolustusliikkeistä. Taitona se määrää kyvyn väistää lähihyökkäyksiä. Lähtötaso perustuu hahmon ketteryyteen, mutta taito kehittyy kokemuksen myötä kuten muutkin taidot.

Puolustusliikkeenä väistö on yritys välttää isku kumartumalla, hypähtämällä tai muuten siirtymällä pois vaarasta. Väistäminen vaatii aina ketteryyttä. Kömpelö suoritus voi johtaa kompastumiseen tai kaatumiseen. Parhaimmillaan nopea ja sulava väistö säästää osumalta ja voi lisäksi antaa taktisen edun. Jos väistö onnistuu vain osittain, puolustajaan osuu, mutta hyökkäyksen voima vähenee vastaavasti.

Väistö tehoaa parhaiten lyhytulotteisiin aseisiin, myös aseettomiin hyökkäyksiin. Hyvin ulottuvan ja korkean hyökkäysluokan aseen väistäminen on paljon haastavampaa.

Väistö voidaan valita puolustusliikkeeksi vain lähihyökkäyksiä vastaan. Etäasehyökkäysten välttämismahdollisuudet lasketaan toisin.

entries.source:
Roundshield is a round shield made of thick, horizontal bands of wood with a fist size hole in the center
where the shield held. The hole is covered by a metallic boss on the exterior. Sometimes the 
circumference is also banded with a metal strip. Roundshields have a diameter between 20-30 inches.
entries.translation: Pyöreä kilpi tehdään paksuista vaakasuuntaisista puulaudoista. Keskellä on nyrkin kokoinen aukko, jonka kohdalta kilpeä pidetään. Ulkopuolelta aukkoa peittää metallinen kilvenkupura. Joskus myös reunaa vahvistaa metallivanne. Pyöreän kilven läpimitta on noin 50 - 75 senttimetriä.

entries.source:
Shields can be used to block enemy strikes and to protect yourself against missile attacks. In melee combat, merely having a shield wielded allows you to use it for blocking when a defense maneuver is to be chosen. To cover yourself against missile attacks, you need to be holding the shield in protective position. Shields can be held in many ways to cover different body parts and to protect from varying lines of missile attacks. It also depends on the shield size how much of your body it can cover. When a shield is held in protective position missile attacks to covered body parts are automatically blocked as they hit the shield instead of you. You get to choose how to hold a shield upon wielding it. The chosen mode can be changed anytime by attack commands keys [1] or [2] - depending on in which hand you're holding the shield. These are the possible shield modes: CENTER - Neutral position where the shield is held in front of you close to your center. In this position roundshields protect from neck to knees. HIGH - The shield is held up in front of you. In this position roundshields protect the head and upper body. It's a good way to cover the vital upper body, but your vision is restricted as you have to peek from behind the shield. SIDE - The shield is held raised by your side. In this position roundshields protect your side from shoulder to knees. If the shield is your primary weapon it's held on your right side, otherwise on the left side.

All of these shield modes make you walk and run slower as the chosen protective grip and stance is carefully maintained during movements. For this reason it's advisable to use protective shield mode only when necessary.

NONE - Shield is carried in relaxed fashion and not held in protective way. As the shield moves freely along with your movements there's no automatic cover provided except for the hand and arm holding the shield.
entries.translation:
Kilvellä voi torjua vihollisen iskuja ja suojautua etäasehyökkäyksiltä. Lähitaistelussa kilven pitäminen kädessä riittää siihen, että voit valita sen torjuntaan puolustusliikettä valitessasi. Etäaseilta suojautuminen vaatii kilven pitämistä suojaavassa asennossa. Kilpeä voi pitää monin tavoin suojaamaan eri ruumiinosia ja eri suunnista tulevia ammuksia. Myös kilven koko vaikuttaa peittävyyteen. Suojaavassa asennossa kilpi torjuu peittämiinsä ruumiinosiin tulevat ammukset automaattisesti: ne osuvat kilpeen sinuun osumisen sijaan. Valitset kilven asennon ottaessasi sen käteen. Voit muuttaa asentoa milloin tahansa hyökkäysnäppäimellä [1] tai [2] sen mukaan, kummassa kädessä kilpi on. Asennot ovat: KESKELLÄ - Neutraali asento, jossa kilpi on edessä lähellä kehon keskikohtaa. Pyöreä kilpi suojaa tällöin kaulasta polviin. YLHÄÄLLÄ - Kilpeä pidetään korkealla edessä. Pyöreä kilpi suojaa päätä ja ylävartaloa. Elintärkeä ylävartalo saa hyvän suojan, mutta näkyvyys rajoittuu, koska joudut kurkistamaan kilven takaa. SIVULLA - Kilpi on kohotettuna sivullasi. Pyöreä kilpi suojaa kylkeä olkapäästä polviin. Jos kilpi on ensisijainen aseesi, se on oikealla; muuten vasemmalla.

Kaikki nämä asennot hidastavat kävelyä ja juoksua, sillä suojaava ote ja asento säilytetään huolellisesti liikkuessakin. Siksi niitä kannattaa käyttää vain tarvittaessa.

EI SUOJAA - Kilpeä kannetaan rennosti ilman suojaavaa asentoa. Se liikkuu vapaasti kehon mukana eikä anna automaattista suojaa muualle kuin sitä pitelevään käteen ja käsivarteen.

entries.source:
Skills such as knife, sword, axe, spear, bow, crossbow etc.
are automatic combat skills for each weapon group. These are automatically
activated everytime you use some weapon.
entries.translation: Puukko-, miekka-, kirves-, keihäs-, jousi-, varsijousi- ja muut asetaidot ovat aseryhmäkohtaisia automaattisia taistelutaitoja. Niitä käytetään automaattisesti aina kyseistä asetta käytettäessä.

entries.source:
Unarmed fighting (kicking,punching etc.). This is an automatic skill and
it's activated everytime you execute unarmed combat maneuver.
entries.translation: Aseeton taistelu tarkoittaa esimerkiksi potkuja ja nyrkiniskuja. Taito toimii automaattisesti aina aseetonta taisteluliikettä tehtäessä.

entries.source: General climbing ability. Used to climb to the mountains and the trees.
entries.translation: Yleinen kiipeilykyky. Sitä käytetään vuorille ja puihin kiipeämiseen.

entries.source:
Skiing is an automatic skill and checked out when you ski. High
mastery in skiing doesn't make you ski faster but with less effort -
you won't get fatigued so soon. To ski you need skis and a ski pole.
entries.translation: Hiihto on automaattinen taito, jota tarkistetaan hiihtäessä. Korkea taitotaso ei lisää nopeutta vaan vähentää rasitusta: et väsy yhtä pian. Hiihtämiseen tarvitaan sukset ja sauva.

entries.source:
The ability to work wood in order to make various handcrafts, utensils
and tools.

Torches are useful to light up caves where you normally can't see anything. They can
also become very handy in providing extra light if you need to travel or work during the dark autumn and winter nights.
Torches are lit by using apply command.
entries.translation: Soihduilla voi valaista luolia, joissa ei normaalisti näe mitään. Ne antavat myös hyödyllistä lisävaloa, jos joudut kulkemaan tai työskentelemään pimeinä syys- ja talviöinä. Soihdut sytytetään käyttökomennolla [a].

entries.source:
Shingles are thin and flat oblong pieces of pine wood which are burnt to produce light - especially for lighting up houses during the dark time of the year. In addition, shingles are also used as handicraft raw material in the making of shingle baskets.
Shingles are lit by using the apply command and once they are burning you can drop and set them wherever the light is needed. So shingles aren't usually carried with you but set around the house as necessary. Shingles were sometimes burnt in a specific stand that keeps them in a good angle for proper burning, but in the game the dropped burning shingles are imagined to be inserted between the wall logs or set firmly in place by some other means.
One shingle doesn't burn very long so to maintain continuos lighting a new shingle needs to be lit before the previous one fades out completely. This sort of shingle replacement is done automatically if your character is located beside the fading shingle and there's a pile of new shingles nearby on the ground. You character then automatically replaces and lits a shingle when neccary, and you don't need to worry about maintaining the lighting even if the task you were doing would take a long time.

Arrow shafts are used in arrowmaking. The tip and fletching is added to the shaft to finish an arrow. 
Quality and straightness of the shaft is very important in order to make good arrows.

A regular arrow has a spearhead shaped iron tip attached to a wooden shaft. These are most common and good overall arrows in hunting and war. They cause small but deep puncture wounds and have the best piercing capabilities of all arrow types.

There are no special types of arrows for regular bows and crossbows so any arrow can be shot with any bow. In addition to regular arrows there are also broadhead arrows and blunt arrows.

After [w]ielding a bow you can shoot arrows by [t]hrow command. To carry a bow readied for a quick first shot you can also wield an arrow beforehand.
entries.translation:
Tavallisessa nuolessa on puuvarteen kiinnitetty keihäänkärjen muotoinen rautakärki. Tällaiset nuolet ovat yleisimpiä ja hyviä yleisnuolia metsästykseen ja sotaan. Ne aiheuttavat pieniä mutta syviä pistohaavoja ja läpäisevät parhaiten kaikista nuolityypeistä.

Tavallisille jousille ja varsijousille ei ole omia nuolityyppejään, joten millä tahansa jousella voi ampua minkä tahansa nuolen. Tavallisten nuolten lisäksi on leveäkärkisiä ja tylppäkärkisiä nuolia.

Otettuasi jousen käteen komennolla [w] voit ampua nuolia heittokomennolla [t]. Nopeaa ensimmäistä laukausta varten voit ottaa myös nuolen valmiiksi käteen. // upd 29-Jun-2014 //

entries.source:
An arrow with a blunt head used to hunt small game without damaging the hide. Blunt arrows have a large club shaped heads and the whole arrow is carved from one piece of wood. Due to their bulky size and weight blunt arrows don't fly as fast as lighter and thinner arrows. For this reason they are left featherless for maximum velocity.
Blunt arrow impact can be enough to kill fragile animals immediately, but their ability to knock animals unconscious is just as effective in order to obtain undamaged hides. Blunt arrows are rarely used to shoot anything bigger than a fox as the impact doesn't hurt larger animals that much - unless they are shot to joints or head from a close distance.

The common arrowhead is made of iron and has a spearhead shaped tip. They cause small but deep puncture wounds and have the best piercing capabilities of all arrow types.

Arowheads can be also made of bone or stone, but these are inferior materials compared to the iron and their usage is usually restricted only to survival situations.
An arrowhead made of iron with two sharp blades. Broadhead arrows are designed to cause large cuts and massive bleeding.

An arrow with the widest cutting head of all arrow types. They usually have two blades 
which are sharpened very carefully. Broadheads are designed to cause large cuts 
and inflict as much bleeding as possible. These arrows are effectively used to hunt large 
game. Even if the hunter wouldn't score immediately fatal hits the bleeding wounds that broadhead 
arrows can cause are often enough to kill the prey sooner or later.
entries.translation: Nuoli, jonka leikkaava kärki on kaikista nuolityypeistä levein. Kärjessä on yleensä kaksi hyvin huolellisesti teroitettua terää. Se on suunniteltu tekemään suuria viiltohaavoja ja aiheuttamaan mahdollisimman runsasta verenvuotoa. Näitä nuolia käytetään tehokkaasti suurriistan pyyntiin. Vaikka osuma ei tappaisi heti, leveäkärkisen nuolen aiheuttama verenvuoto riittää usein surmaamaan saaliin ennemmin tai myöhemmin.

entries.source: A wooden container. Can be used to carry water, milk etc.

A closed wooden container used to carry water, milk or other beverages. It's made out of small staves bound
together with withe hoops. Wooden canteens are round or slightly oval in shape and resemble 
a small, short keg. They are closed by a wooden plug and also have a cord for carrying over the shoulder.

A rectangular container made of shingles arranged in overlapping weave pattern. The handles are traditionally made of 
birch withes but other kind of cordage can be used as well. Shingle basket is a rather large container but 
very light compared to its size.

A tendon is a fibrous connective tissue that attaches muscle to bone. Tendons of butchered animals are used in 
making of sinew yarn.

Sinew fibre is separated from dried animal tendons by using your textilecraft skill. The dried tendons are pounded on
hard surface to break and soften them until fluffy fibres can be pulled apart. 
Sinew fibres can be then twisted together to make sinew yarn.

Sinew yarn is a strong, durable thread made from the fibrous tendons of animals. It is commonly used for sewing leather and fur, as well as for various crafting and binding tasks, such as attaching arrowheads. However, sinew yarn cannot be used for fishing tackle, as it weakens and stretches when wet.

To make sinew yarn, you first need animal tendons. These can be harvested from butchered animals of relatively large size. Leg tendons of large mammals, such as elk and reindeer, are preferred, but tendons from smaller animals can also be used, though they yield less useful sinew. Tendons are processed into sinew yarn using your TEXTILECRAFT skill through the following stages of work:

TENDON DRYING - First of all, fresh tendons need to be dried. They are spread out flat or hung in a dry, preferably warm place until stiff. This takes a day or two.

SEPARATE SINEW FIBRE - Next, the dried tendon is pounded with a club or similar tool on a hard surface until the sinew fibres begin to separate. The fluffy, thin fibres are then pulled apart and collected by hand into small bundles.

SINEW YARN - Finally, the obtained sinew fibres can be twisted together to form sinew yarn. This is done entirely by hand, as a spindle cannot be used. The fibres are occasionally moistened in the mouth to make them easier to handle and join as the yarn is being made.
entries.translation:
Jännelanka on eläinten säikeisistä jänteistä tehtyä lujaa ja kestävää lankaa. Sitä käytetään yleisesti nahan ja turkiksen ompeluun sekä erilaisiin käsitöihin ja sidoksiin, kuten nuolenkärkien kiinnittämiseen. Kalastusvälineisiin se ei kuitenkaan sovi, sillä se heikkenee ja venyy kastuessaan.

Valmistukseen tarvitaan ensin eläinten jänteitä. Niitä saa teurastetuista, melko suurista eläimistä. Suurten nisäkkäiden, kuten hirven ja poron, jalkajänteitä suositaan. Pienempienkin eläinten jänteet käyvät, mutta niistä saa vähemmän käyttökelpoista kuitua. Jänteet jalostetaan langaksi tekstiilityötaidolla (TEKSTIILITYÖ) seuraavissa vaiheissa:

JÄNTEIDEN KUIVAUS - Tuoreet jänteet kuivataan ensin. Ne levitetään suoriksi tai ripustetaan kuivaan, mieluiten lämpimään paikkaan, kunnes ne jäykistyvät. Tämä vie päivän tai kaksi.

JÄNNEKUIDUN EROTTAMINEN - Kuivattua jännettä hakataan nuijalla tai vastaavalla työkalulla kovaa alustaa vasten, kunnes säikeet alkavat erota. Pöyheät, ohuet kuidut vedetään käsin irti ja kootaan pieniksi nipuiksi.

JÄNNELANKA - Lopuksi kuidut kierretään yhteen jännelangaksi. Työ tehdään kokonaan käsin, sillä värttinää ei voi käyttää. Kuituja kostutetaan välillä suussa, jotta niitä olisi helpompi käsitellä ja liittää yhteen lankaa tehtäessä. // added Mar-24-2021 // updated Nov-14-2025 //

entries.source:
Cloth is a base material for crafting various garments. Cloth can be woven from linen, hemp, nettle or wool yarn and it is produced in a standard width of two feet. Cloth lengths vary from a few feet to a maximum length of around 10 feet. As cloth is woven on an upright loom, often indoors, there is a limit to its practical length.
Cultivated plant-fibre cloth is the most valuable type of cloth. Linen being the most expensive, followed by hemp. Wool cloth is more affordable and thus more commonly used, especially for making outer garments, than plant-fibre-based cloth. Wool cloth is roughly half the price of linen cloth. This is because of the much higher workload required to produce plant-fibre cloth. Nettle cloth is the least expensive, but nevertheless a practical and commonly used alternative to more luxurious linen.
All the eastern and western cultures, except for the islanders, can produce cloth, and depending on the exact culture, lengths of linen, hemp, nettle or wool cloth are sometimes available for trade in their villages.
entries.translation:
Kangas on monenlaisten vaatteiden perusmateriaali. Sitä kudotaan pellava-, hamppu-, nokkos- tai villalangasta. Kankaan tavallinen leveys on kaksi jalkaa. Palojen pituus vaihtelee muutamasta jalasta noin kymmeneen jalkaan. Kangasta kudotaan pystykangaspuilla, usein sisätiloissa, mikä rajoittaa sen käytännöllistä pituutta.
Viljeltyjen kuitukasvien kankaat ovat arvokkaimpia: pellava on kalleinta, sitten hamppu. Villakangas on edullisempaa ja siksi yleisempää etenkin päällysvaatteissa. Se maksaa suunnilleen puolet pellavakankaan hinnasta, sillä kasvikuitukankaan valmistus vaatii paljon enemmän työtä. Nokkoskangas on halvinta, mutta käytännöllinen ja yleinen vaihtoehto hienommalle pellavalle.
Kaikki itäiset ja läntiset kulttuurit saaristolaisia lukuun ottamatta valmistavat kangasta. Kulttuurista riippuen kylissä on toisinaan kaupan pellava-, hamppu-, nokkos- tai villakangasta.

entries.source:
Textilecraft involves extracting plant or sinew fibres and spinning them into yarn. Flax, hemp, and nettle are the plants from which plant fibres can be obtained. Sinew yarn is made from animal tendons. A character's expertise in textilecraft affects the required working times and the amount of usable fibre or yarn produced. Processing plant fibres into yarn involves several stages of work as follows:

RETTING - After harvesting, the fibres must be separated from the plant stalks. This process, called retting, involves soaking the plants in water for several days. The duration depends on water temperature, with warmer water speeding up retting. Retting does not occur in very cold water, so it cannot be done in winter.

DRYING - Once retting is complete, the plant stalks are removed from the water and left to dry outdoors in loose bundles. They must dry fully to be easily crushed in the next work phase of extracting the fibre. Drying takes about a week, after which the dried stalks can be stored for later or processed for fibre as needed.

EXTRACT FIBRE - The fibres can now be extracted from the stalks. This is done by breaking the dried, retted stalks so the woody core shatters and falls away, leaving the loose fibres free. The stalks are beaten, for example with a club on a solid surface. It's hard work, usually done by several people together. There is an old custom of arranging village work parties for fibre processing with neighbouring households. Obtained bundles of fibre are then scraped free of remaining coarse parts, either with tools at hand or by rubbing and whacking them against a hard surface.
Nettle fibres can be extracted directly by hand from the stalks, even without retting. Simply use the extract option directly on freshly harvested nettles.

SPIN YARN - Finally, the obtained bundles of fibre can be spun into yarn. Spinning can be done either by hand, which is slower, or using a spindle.

To make sinew yarn, a spindle cannot be used; it is made entirely by hand and naturally involves different work stages.
entries.translation:
Tekstiilityöhön kuuluu kasvi- ja jännekuitujen irrottaminen sekä niiden kehrääminen langaksi. Kasvikuituja saadaan pellavasta, hampusta ja nokkosesta. Jännelanka tehdään eläinten jänteistä. Taitotaso vaikuttaa työaikaan ja saadun käyttökelpoisen kuidun tai langan määrään. Kasvikuidun valmistus langaksi etenee seuraavasti:

LIOTUS - Sadonkorjuun jälkeen kuidut täytyy irrottaa varsista. Tätä varten kasveja liotetaan vedessä useita päiviä. Kesto riippuu veden lämpötilasta: lämpö nopeuttaa liotusta. Hyvin kylmässä vedessä liotusta ei tapahdu, joten talvella sitä ei voi tehdä.

KUIVAUS - Liotetut varret nostetaan vedestä kuivumaan ulos löyhiin nippuihin. Niiden täytyy kuivua täysin, jotta ne on helppo murskata seuraavassa työvaiheessa. Kuivaus vie noin viikon. Sitten varret voi varastoida tai niistä voi irrottaa kuitua tarpeen mukaan.

KUIDUN IRROTUS - Kuivatut, liotetut varret rikotaan, jotta puumainen ydin murskautuu ja putoaa pois ja kuidut vapautuvat. Varsia hakataan esimerkiksi nuijalla kovalla alustalla. Työ on raskasta ja tehdään yleensä yhdessä. Vanhan tavan mukaan naapuritaloudet kokoontuvatkin kylän yhteisiin kuidunkäsittelytalkoisiin. Saadut kuituniput puhdistetaan jäljelle jääneistä karkeista osista kaapimalla sopivilla välineillä tai hankaamalla ja hakkaamalla kovaa pintaa vasten.
Nokkosen kuidut voi irrottaa varsista suoraan käsin ilman liotustakin. Käytä tällöin kuitujen irrotusta suoraan vasta korjattuihin nokkosiin.

LANGAN KEHRUU - Lopuksi kuituniput kehrätään langaksi. Sen voi tehdä hitaammin käsin tai värttinällä.

Jännelankaan ei voi käyttää värttinää. Se tehdään kokonaan käsin ja vaatii luonnollisesti erilaiset työvaiheet.

entries.source:
Weatherlore is the ability to predict and observe the weather. With
a succesful attempt you may be able to predict the weather for
future hours. Sometimes you don't find out more than just how the
weather is. Of course it's possible to make faulty predictions,
sometimes even just the opposite.
entries.translation: Säätieto on kyky havainnoida ja ennustaa säätä. Onnistunut yritys voi paljastaa tulevien tuntien sään. Joskus selviää vain nykyinen säätila. Ennuste voi tietenkin olla väärä, joskus jopa täysin päinvastainen kuin toteutuva sää.

entries.source:
The ability to grow crops and harvest wild plants for seeds and leaves. 
Commonly cultivated plants include turnips, broad beans, hemp, rye and barley.
However, it is possible to grow any plant as long as you manage to obtain its 
seeds. Agriculture consists of tilling, sowing, harvesting, threshing and 
grinding.

Before it's possible to sow a field, the soil must be prepared in order to make 
it fertile and cultivable. 
This is most commonly done via slash-and-burn cultivation, which can be done by
felling trees and burning them in the field. When the fire has burnt out the 
soil can be tilled. As this is hard work, you may find yourself satisfied even 
with a small field.

When the soil has been tilled, the sowing can take place. 
The main sowing season is in the early summer, but as different plants mature
at different times this may vary. Some fast-growing plants may even be able to 
produce two harvests a year. It is also possible to sow some crops in the late 
autumn so that they will start sprouting as early in the spring as possible. 
This is commonly practiced with rye.

When the plants have ripened it's time to harvest them. 
Most wild plants and crops also may be harvested by merely picking them up,
but grains must be harvested via the actual harvest option. In addition, this
is the only way to collect the seeds from a plant - and also the fastest way to
process large quantities of any crop. The harvested crops must then be threshed.

Threshing is an act of separating the usable parts from the rest of the 
harvested plant. It is most often done with grain to separate the grain itself 
from the straw, but can be done with any plant. When threshing is complete the 
separated grain, seeds, roots, leaves etc. may be collected.

Grinding is used to produce flour from grains. This is done by hand, using two 
grinding stones. The resulting flour tends to be coarse but valuable.
entries.translation:
Kyky kasvattaa viljelykasveja ja korjata luonnonkasveista siemeniä ja lehtiä. Tavallisia viljelykasveja ovat nauris, härkäpapu, hamppu, ruis ja ohra. Mitä tahansa kasvia voi kuitenkin kasvattaa, jos onnistuu saamaan sen siemeniä. Maanviljelyyn kuuluvat maan muokkaus, kylvö, sadonkorjuu, puinti ja jauhatus.

Ennen kylvämistä maa täytyy valmistella hedelmälliseksi ja viljelykelpoiseksi. Tavallisimmin tämä tehdään kaskeamalla: puut kaadetaan ja poltetaan viljelyalalla. Tulen sammuttua maan voi muokata. Työ on raskasta, joten pienikin pelto saattaa riittää tarpeisiisi.

Muokattuun maahan voi kylvää. Tärkein kylvöaika on alkukesä, mutta eri kasvien kypsymisajat vaihtelevat. Joistakin nopeasti kasvavista kasveista voi saada jopa kaksi satoa vuodessa. Joitakin voi myös kylvää myöhään syksyllä, jolloin ne alkavat itää keväällä mahdollisimman aikaisin. Näin tehdään yleisesti rukiille.

Kasvien kypsyttyä on sadonkorjuun aika. Useimmat luonnon- ja viljelykasvit voi korjata vain poimimalla, mutta vilja täytyy korjata varsinaisella sadonkorjuutoiminnolla. Tämä on myös ainoa tapa kerätä kasvin siemeniä ja nopein tapa käsitellä suuria määriä mitä tahansa satoa. Korjattu sato täytyy sitten puida.

Puinnissa erotetaan korjatun kasvin käyttökelpoiset osat muusta kasvista. Yleisimmin erotetaan jyvät oljista, mutta toiminnon voi tehdä mille tahansa kasville. Puinnin valmistuttua erotetut jyvät, siemenet, juuret, lehdet ja muut osat voi kerätä.

Jauhatuksessa viljanjyvistä tehdään jauhoja. Työ tehdään käsin kahdella jauhinkivellä. Jauhoista tulee melko karkeita mutta arvokkaita.

// added & proofred 10-Oct-2012
//

entries.source:
The ability to move silently and without being detected.

Stealth-skill is checked every time your character advances while sneaking. You can start sneaking by using [h]ide
command. It should be understood that sneaking doesn't make you invisible. Foremost, stealth is a skill that helps to
decrease the noise you make while advancing. To some degree stealth-skill also determines your character's ability to
use available cover to avoid being seen directly. If you sneak in front of someone in the open, they probably can see
you as well as you can see them. Therefore it's always best practice to sneak upon your target from behind, and along
a path that provides reasonable cover. Stealth-skill is also subject to physical penalties for it's more difficult
to move silently if you are injured or carrying heavy loads.

There are also additional factors which may interfere with the success of sneaking upon on your target. Distance to
target, available cover and the acuity of the observers senses all affect to how easy, or difficult, somebody is to
detect. Many animals have superior hearing and sense of smell and therefore sneaking on animals can sometimes result
in getting just a few steps closer to your prey before it spots you. But often closing the distance even a little
can be a crucial advantage in hunting.

Building is the ability to construct forms of shelters and housing. Durable wooden buildings are usually for 
permanent occupation but this skill can also be used to construct other dwellings such as kotas, and more simple, 
temporary shelters, as well as other structures like fences. Timbercraft is a secondary skill to building, 
since the wood that trees provide will be used extensively in the construction process.
A skill to treat wounds, injuries and medical ailments. A successful wound treatment will improve the healing.
entries.translation:
Taito hoitaa haavoja, vammoja ja vaivoja. Onnistunut haavanhoito edistää paranemista.

// updated 21-jan-2016

entries.source:
Timbercraft is a general ability to cut down trees and produce rough lumber like logs, boards, firewood and such.
Cutting branches and peeling bark from a tree are also covered by the timbercraft skill.
entries.translation: Puunkäsittely on yleinen kyky kaataa puita ja valmistaa karkeaa puutavaraa, kuten hirsiä, lautoja ja polttopuita. Myös oksien katkominen ja kuoren irrottaminen puusta kuuluvat taitoon.

entries.source:
General swimming. Swimming is possible on the zoomed in local map.
Use this skill while facing the water to move forward. If you have
a low swimming skill you could be in danger of drowning.
entries.translation: Yleinen uimataito. Uiminen onnistuu lähikartalla. Käytä taitoa veteen päin katsoessasi liikkuaksesi eteenpäin. Heikko uimataito voi altistaa hukkumiselle.

entries.source:
The ability to recognize and follow tracks. Upon finding some tracks you will 
gain information from them according to your tracking mastery. Tracking can be 
used both on the zoomed-in map and the wilderness map. On the wilderness map 
tracking is signficantly more difficult if you don't have a good idea of the 
animal's location beforehand, but random tracking is still practiced by hunters 
searching for new game. On the zoomed-in map animal tracks can be visually 
spotted from a close distance if the print left matches the level of your 
tracking skill. Obtaining more information calls for using the tracking skill 
at a preferred track's location. Sometimes it's not worthwhile to use the 
tracking skill on every new track you find, but to draw a conclusion as to 
where the animal may be heading to and hurry ahead.
 
Whether the animal leaves a visible print at a given location or not depends 
greatly on the type of ground as well as the type (especially the weight) of 
the animal itself. Winter is the best season for tracking since even the 
smallest animals will leave prints on the snow - which even an inexperienced 
tracker can find.
 
Tracking and spotting tracks while moving about can be used not only in order
to actively follow your prey, but also as an indicator of animal activity in a 
certain area - for it's wise to set your fox-trap in an area you where find 
signs of recent fox activity. However the success of your traps is measured by
your trapping skill.

The ability to recognize individual plants and their properties.
The most common plants are known to everyone, but knowledge of the rest depends on
your character's culture and their herblore skills. Herblore skill is used not only to
recognize unknown plants but also to display plant properties and medicinal effects as you
know, or have learned them. If a plant to be examined is completely known to your character,
its true name, properties and medicinal effects will be shown in full. Otherwise you'll gain
only the bits of information that meet your level of knowledge.

To truly improve in herblore it's almost mandatory to experiment with plants in every possible
way you can think of - or feel safe about. When there's a noticeable effect from any kind of
plant usage, it is memorized by your character and their knowledge of the plant increases
accordingly. So it is possible to find herbs helpful in wound treatment or mushrooms that are
poisonous by trial and error, even if the plant's indentity stays a mystery for your character.
Some herbal effects, however, aren't clearly noticeable and that's why it pays to improve your
herblore knowledge to a level where you will be able to recognize the plants and their properties completely.

In general, the more common the plant, the easier it is to recognize. In the case of plants that are very rare
or unfamiliar to your character, it takes more experimenting and higher herblore skills to come up with the 
recognition. But do remember that every herblore attempt will benefit your character's overall knowledge of the vegetable kingdom.

Clothcraft is a general skill for making clothes from a variety of materials. 
Success in clothcraft determines the quality of the clothes produced.
Two subsidiary skills are often needed if a character produces all the raw materials for clothing themselves; 
TEXTILECRAFT for producing yarn for sewing, and HIDEWORKING for processing hides into usable fur or leather.

The bowyer skill is the ability and knowledge to make bows. 
Success in the bowyer skill determines the quality of the bows crafted.

Netmaking is a skill for weaving and constructing fishing nets, and crafting a lippo.
Success in netmaking determines the quality of the nets or the lippo crafted.

Trapping is a skill that not only covers your ability to construct various
traps, but also determines your success in setting said traps. Tracking is a
useful skill that most trappers also learn, but it can only tell you whether or
not there is any animal activity at that site. Actually catching the animal
depends on your trapping skill.

Even the most perfect trap may fail to catch anything if set by an
inexperienced trapper, for they will have overlooked important points such as
clearing all traces of human scent from both the bait and the surrounding area.
Badly set or badly made traps may even scare off certain animals, though an
improperly set trap more commonly results in premature triggering or the trap
not managing to catch the target animal, causing light or no injury at all.

The more complex the trap is, the higher skill will be needed to make a decent 
trap. With luck, clever trap placement, and by using simple traps (like loop 
snares and trap-pits) even the least experienced of trappers can expect a catch 
from time to time. A master trapper can draw in hungry predators from far away, 
lured into a perfectly concealed trap complemented by irresistible, seemingly 
harmless bait.
entries.translation:
Ansapyyntitaito kattaa erilaisten ansojen rakentamisen ja määrää myös niiden virittämisen onnistumisen. Jäljitys on hyödyllinen taito, jonka useimmat ansapyytäjät oppivat, mutta se kertoo vain, liikkuuko paikalla eläimiä. Itse saaliin saaminen riippuu ansapyyntitaidosta.

Täydellinenkin ansa voi jäädä tyhjäksi kokemattoman pyytäjän virittämänä. Hän on saattanut unohtaa tärkeitä seikkoja, kuten ihmisen hajun poistamisen syötistä ja ympäristöstä. Huonosti tehty tai asetettu ansa voi jopa karkottaa joitakin eläimiä. Tavallisemmin väärä viritys kuitenkin laukaisee ansan liian varhain tai estää sitä saamaan eläintä kiinni, jolloin syntyy vain lievä vamma tai ei vammaa lainkaan.

Mitä monimutkaisempi ansa, sitä enemmän taitoa sen kunnollinen rakentaminen vaatii. Onnella, viisaalla sijoittelulla ja yksinkertaisilla ansoilla, kuten lanka-ansoilla ja pyyntikuopilla, kokemattominkin pyytäjä voi odottaa satunnaista saalista. Mestari voi houkutella nälkäisiä petoja kaukaa täydellisesti kätkettyyn ansaan vastustamattomalla, vaarattomalta näyttävällä syötillä.

entries.source:
Hideworking is used to skin animals and process the resulting hides. Success in
hideworking determines the quality of the hide produced. Poor quality furs and
leathers are worth of only a fraction of the good quality ones and hides of 
some animals are more valuable than others. Hides of fox, lynx, beaver and 
pine-marten are for example very sought after. Furthermore, a thick winter fur
is most valuable.
  There are several hideworking options available:

  SKINNING - To skin the dead animal you must stand beside the carcass. Fresh 
animal skins should be tanned within a few days or be cured for preservation - 
otherwise they will start to rot.

  CLEANING - First of all the fresh skin needs to be cleaned of all remaining 
flesh and fat. Only then can it be tanned or cured for preservation.

  CURING - As tanning can be a long and laborous task, curing can be used to 
preserve the skin for later processing. Curing means basically drying a clean 
skin to keep it from decaying. Cured skins will stay good practically forever 
and can be tanned later on.

  TANNING - Tanning is a multi-stage task requiring soaking the skin, applying 
tanning material, rinsing the skin clean again and finally mechanically 
softening the skin. This calls for several "Tan the skin" commands per skin 
until you'll finally obtain a fur or leather - depending on the animal whose 
skin was processed. Each tanning step also affects the skin quality and the 
whole process should be carried out with no delays to prevent the skin rotting
during the process.

  DEHAIR - Dehairing is used to remove the hair from the hide of a fur-bearing
animal. This way tanning the hide will produce leather, which one can sometimes
prefer.

Tanned fur or leather can be used in the making of clothes - or in trading.
Fresh, cured or only partly processed skins are not considered valuable.
entries.translation:
Nahanmuokkauksella nyljetään eläimiä ja käsitellään saatuja vuotia. Onnistuminen määrää tuotetun nahan laadun. Huonot turkikset ja nahat ovat vain murto-osan hyvälaatuisten arvoisia, ja joidenkin eläinten nahat ovat muita arvokkaampia. Esimerkiksi ketun, ilveksen, majavan ja näädän turkikset ovat hyvin haluttuja. Paksu talviturkki on kaikkein arvokkain. Käytettävissä on useita toimintoja:

NYLKEMINEN - Seiso ruhon vieressä nylkeäksesi eläimen. Tuore vuota on parkittava muutamassa päivässä tai kuivattava säilytystä varten, muuten se alkaa mädäntyä.

PUHDISTUS - Tuoreesta vuodasta poistetaan ensin kaikki jäljellä oleva liha ja rasva. Vasta sitten sen voi parkita tai kuivata säilytettäväksi.

KUIVAUS - Parkitus voi olla pitkä ja työläs tehtävä, joten vuodan voi kuivata myöhempää käsittelyä varten. Puhdas vuota kuivataan pilaantumisen estämiseksi. Kuivatut vuodat säilyvät käytännössä ikuisesti ja voidaan parkita myöhemmin.

PARKITUS - Monivaiheinen työ vaatii vuodan liottamista, parkitusaineen levittämistä, puhtaaksi huuhtelua ja lopuksi mekaanista pehmittämistä. Samalle vuodalle tarvitaan useita parkituskomentoja, kunnes saat eläinlajista riippuen turkiksen tai nahan. Jokainen vaihe vaikuttaa laatuun. Koko työ on tehtävä viivyttelemättä, jotta vuota ei mätäne kesken käsittelyn.

KARVANPOISTO - Turkiseläimen vuodasta poistetaan karvat. Tällöin parkitus tuottaa nahkaa, mikä voi joskus olla toivottavaa.

Parkittua turkista ja nahkaa käytetään vaatteisiin tai vaihtokauppaan. Tuoreita, kuivattuja tai vain osittain käsiteltyjä vuotia ei pidetä arvokkaina.

// added 20-Fen-2023
//

entries.source:
Smoking is the process of preserving meat or fish by exposing it to smoke in a heated room. In unreal world this is cold smoking process and takes a few weeks to complete. The meat or fish smoked this way preserves for a long time.
The smoking requires hanging the meat or fish in the room by cords or other tying equipment, and continous maintaining of fire. It's not critical to maintain an exact temperature but the fireplace in your smoking cabin should be warmed up properly on daily basis. Should you forget it one day it's still possible to compensate by heating it up even more the next day.
If the heating is completely neglected you will find your smoked foodstuff all spoiled. If the heating has failed only to some extent you may find some of the smoked foods spoiled.
The smoking is initiated by using your COOKERY skill.
entries.translation:
Savustus säilöö lihaa ja kalaa altistamalla sen savulle lämmitetyssä huoneessa. UnReal Worldissa menetelmä on kylmäsavustus, joka kestää muutamia viikkoja. Näin savustettu liha ja kala säilyvät pitkään.
Liha tai kala ripustetaan huoneeseen nyöreillä tai muilla sidontavälineillä, ja tulta on ylläpidettävä jatkuvasti. Tarkka lämpötila ei ole ratkaiseva, mutta savutuvan tulisija on lämmitettävä kunnolla päivittäin. Yhden päivän unohduksen voi vielä korvata lämmittämällä seuraavana päivänä enemmän.
Jos lämmitys laiminlyödään kokonaan, kaikki savustettava ruoka pilaantuu. Osittainen laiminlyönti voi pilata osan ruoasta.
Savustus aloitetaan ruoanlaittotaidolla: RUOANLAITTO.

entries.source:
Cookery is the ability to prepare and preserve food. The simplest cooking 
methods, such as boiling and roasting, are often used when preparing food in
the wild and can be used for practically any kind of raw food: meat, fish or a
wide variety of plants. More complicated recipes use more advanced cooking 
techniques, a larger range of ingredients and more cooking implements, though
they also produce a much larger variety of food. Some source of heat is almost
always required. A knife, a pot, bowl or cup are the most basic cooking
utensils.

Different plants have different effects. Some may be poisonous, have medicinal 
values or other effects. For this reason, plants (especially mushrooms) are 
often boiled first before use, and this is the method most commonly used to 
create herbal beverages.

In addition to cooking food for immediate consumption, cookery also covers
three basic preservation methods, which are drying, smoking and salting. 
These are used when large quantities of meat or fish are obtained and must be
preserved for later use. Depending on the method used the meat will last for
different lengths of time. Preserved food can stay edible for weeks or even 
months, extremely useful in times of scarcity, such as the harsh winter.

Your character's physical performance and mastery of skills will be impaired 
due to physical penalties which are classified as encumbrance, fatigue, 
injury and starvation. These penalties reflect the fact that a character who
is carrying extensive load, fatigued, injured or starving cannot function 
normally. 

There's a meter for each physical penalty showing the percentage value of the
negative effect. The sum of all four penalties is your character's total 
physical penalty - a negative percentage value working against you when using 
skills and also lowering your mobility.

When using skills that require even a moderate physical activity your 
character's total physical penalty is substracted from the skill mastery level. 
For example:
If your swimming mastery level is 45% and your total physical penalty is -15% 
the effective swimming success is modified down to 30%. 

For a better skill performance in demanding tasks it's wise to pay attention 
to your physical penalties, and if possible, ease the physical strain by 
dropping excess load, resting away the fatigue or even waiting for your wounds 
to heal or to recover from starvation.
This is especially important when using weapons, crafting or building and
anytime your life is at stake or you aim for the best result possible.

Your character may start to starve from poor and insufficient nutrition. 
The basic cause of starvation is an imbalance between energy intake and energy
expenditure. In other words, you expend more energy than you take in as food. 
Starvation is a severe condition which will affect your character's physical 
performance and can eventually lead to death.

The nutrition dialog box will tell when your character is starving. For as long
the condition lasts, starvation gets more and more severe, increasing the 
starvation penalty - which impairs your ability to function normally, like all
the physical penalties do. Severity of starvation is shown by the starvation 
meter which also displays the amount of said penalty. 

Recovery from prolonged starvation can be a lengthy process. In general you 
need to eat more often and ensure that the food provides enough nutrition and 
energy. To gain back lost energy reserves it's also advisable to avoid 
unnecessary strenuous activity. When your character's is back on sufficient
diet, starvation will start to ease bit by bit.
entries.translation:
Hahmo voi alkaa nälkiintyä huonosta ja riittämättömästä ravinnosta. Perussyy on energiansaannin ja kulutuksen epätasapaino: kulutat enemmän energiaa kuin saat ruoasta. Nälkiintyminen on vakava tila, joka heikentää ruumiillista toimintakykyä ja voi lopulta johtaa kuolemaan.

Ravitsemusikkuna kertoo, kun hahmo nälkiintyy. Tilan jatkuessa nälkiintyminen pahenee ja sen aiheuttama haitta kasvaa. Se vaikeuttaa normaalia toimintaa kuten muutkin ruumiilliset haitat. Vakavuuden ja haitan määrän näyttää nälkiintymismittari.

Pitkittyneestä nälkiintymisestä toipuminen voi kestää kauan. Yleensä on syötävä useammin ja huolehdittava ruoan riittävästä ravinto- ja energiasisällöstä. Menetettyjen energiavarojen palauttamiseksi kannattaa välttää turhaa rasitusta. Kun hahmo saa jälleen riittävää ravintoa, nälkiintyminen alkaa hellittää vähitellen.

entries.source:
Fatigue is one of the physical penalties, accumulated by strenuous physical activities such
as fighting, running or swimming. The level of physical effort affects the fatigue accumulation
rate. In one's daily activities, there can be slightly fatiguing tasks, extremely strenuous jobs,
and everything in between. The character's physical attributes and carried load also play
important parts in fatigue accumulation. Characters with low endurance will accrue fatigue more easily
and any physical activity is naturally that much harder if you are carrying an excessive load.

Fatigue can be alleviated by resting or doing light tasks that do not accumulate fatigue.
Even peaceful walking without excess load will decrease fatigue.

Fatigue has the same effect on animals as it has on humans. This is something to remember when hunting
as fatigue also decreases mobility. Animals have distinct species specific fatigue rates which play an
important part in their hunting and escaping behaviour. It is not always about how fast an animal can run,
but how fast it will tire or how much endurance it has as a runner.

In general, the more weight a character is carrying, the harder the physical activities come. As one of the physical penalties this is called encumbrance.
Character's endurance attribute has a significant effect on how much encumbrance penalty they suffer from carried load.
entries.translation:
Mitä enemmän painoa hahmo kantaa, sitä raskaampaa ruumiillinen toiminta yleensä on. Tätä ruumiillista haittaa kutsutaan kuormitukseksi.
Hahmon kestävyys vaikuttaa huomattavasti siihen, kuinka paljon haittaa kantamuksesta syntyy.

entries.source:
Mobility refers to your character's movement rate - how fast you can
walk or run. Your initial mobility value is based on your character's 
speed attribute, but in practice you rarely travel at top speed. 
Mobility is subject to physical penalties like the load you are carrying, 
fatigue and injuries. Your manner of moving also affects effective 
mobility as it will be different from your walking speed if you are 
running, swimming, crawling or skiing. The mobility indicator shows your
effective mobility in kilometers per hour (km/h). That's the speed your 
character will move with all your current penalties and your current 
manner of movement taken in the consideration.
entries.translation: Liikkuvuus tarkoittaa hahmon liikkumisnopeutta eli kävelyn tai juoksun vauhtia. Lähtöarvo perustuu nopeusominaisuuteen, mutta käytännössä kuljet harvoin huippuvauhtia. Liikkuvuutta heikentävät ruumiilliset haitat, kuten kantamus, väsymys ja vammat. Myös liikkumistapa vaikuttaa: juoksun, uinnin, ryömimisen ja hiihdon nopeudet eroavat kävelystä. Mittari näyttää käytännön liikkuvuuden kilometreinä tunnissa (km/h). Tällä nopeudella hahmo liikkuu nykyiset haitat ja liikkumistapa huomioiden.

entries.source:
Valuables are decorated items made of rare materials. They have little or no practical use, but are mostly worn or carried as a sign of wealth and prosperity. However, some of the symbols used in valuables do have magical associations, and silver is even used in certain sacrifices.

Many different types of valuables are crafted by the cultures of the Unreal World. Finer and more expensive valuables are bartered from the foreign traders.

Valuables in UnReal World are:
BROOCH, BRONZE HORSE-ORNAMENTED COMB, BRONZE FLOWER-ORNAMENTED COMB,
SILVER CHAIN BRACELET, BRONZE BRACELET, SILVER BIRD BRACELET,
SILVER RING, BEZEL RING,
BRONZE BEAR PENDANT, SILVER SUN-SYMBOL PENDANT, BRONZE BALL PENDANT.

A round, decorated brooch made of bronze. Small brooches are commonly used to hold the front of a tunic or a shirt closed. Larger ones are used to fasten cloaks and overcoats, or worn as mere ornaments.
Different variants of the bronze brooch are manufactured by craftsmen in Driik, Koivula and Reemi. Ones crafted in Driik and Koivula are typically decorated either with lines and dots, or flower ornaments. Craftsmen of Reemi decorate their brooches with engraved figures of elk, bear or horse.

Palm-sized comb with the back of the handle crafted into a shape of two horse heads facing to opposite directions.
Different variants of the comb are manufactured in Reemi. Similar type of comb is also imported by foreign traders. 
The comb is not for common day-to-day use, but carried as a decorative item on special occasions.

Palm-sized comb with the handle decorated with engraved flower ornaments. Different variants of the comb are manufactured both in Driik and
imported by foreign traders. The comb is not for common day-to-day use, but carried as a decorative item on special occasions

Three finely crafted thin silver chains braided to form a single bracelet. This kind of valuables are crafted overseas, and sold by
foreign traders. Both the amount of silver and the decorative quality make this bracelet a highly valued item.
Wearing one is a sign of wealth and status.

A simple bracelet decorated with engraved curly lines and dots. Craftsmen of Driik and Koivula make this type of bracelets.
The bracelet is worn by women of western cultures.

A ring made of silver with a decoration composed of dots and curly lines running all around the outer side of the ring.
This type of rings are sold and imported by foreign traders, but also produced by skilled craftsmen of Driik.

A ring with a wide bezel decorated with a relief figure. Common figures are an eagle, a bear head, and an aquatic bird.
Imported by foreign traders, this type of ring is favored by the wealthy men among eastern and northern tribes.

A small figure of an aquatic bird is attached to the other end of this thin bracelet. These bracelets are imported by the foreign traders. 
This type is worn by women of eastern and northern cultures.

A relief figure of a bear head and forepaws, cast in bronze. This type of pendant is imported by the foreign traders. 
The pendant often comes without a chain, so it is often attached to a simple leather cord. It is worn on rituals, celebrations and other special
occasions by men of eastern cultures.

A round pendant nearly two inches wide, picturing a sun symbol inside a decorated rim.
This fine piece of jewelry is imported by the foreign traders.
Northern and Eastern peoples like this pendant, as they believe the sun symbol is associated with fertility, health and good luck.

A hollow bronze ball, usually a little less than an inch in diameter. The ball is decorated with embossed pebbles, forming lines round the ball.
The ball hangs from a thin bronze chain. This type of pendant is sold by the foreign traders and worn by women of western cultures.
entries.translation: Ontto pronssipallo, jonka läpimitta on yleensä hieman alle 2,5 senttimetriä. Palloa koristavat sitä kiertävät kohoumarivit. Se riippuu ohuesta pronssiketjusta. Näitä riipuksia myyvät ulkomaiset kauppiaat, ja niitä käyttävät läntisten kulttuurien naiset.

entries.source:
Some of these items are descriped here:
 SALT, POT.
entries.translation:
Joitakin näistä käyttöesineistä kuvataan täällä:
SUOLA, PATA.

entries.source: Salt is used in cookery, e.g. in the making of salted meat/fish.

Pot is a cooking vessel made of iron, used in cookery for preparing food. It has a deep, round shape with high sides and is designed to hold liquids or ingredients while cooking over heat. Pots can be used for cooking over an open flame, on hot coals, or in a fireplace, making them suitable for all types of cooking.
An iron pot is a durable cooking tool that can last a lifetime, but if an iron pot is not affordable or available, a birch-bark pot, suitable for wilderness situations, can be used as an alternative.

Birch-bark pot is a traditional cooking vessel made from a single sheet of birch bark, carefully shaped into a rectangular form. The seams of the bark are sealed tightly by pressing the edges together with short pieces of twigs, which are split at one end to hold the bark in place. This design allows the pot to hold liquids, such as water, and be used for cooking over an open fire.
It is essential to manage the heat carefully to prevent the bark from catching fire, ensuring that the water heats up without damaging the pot. While the birch-bark pot is a lightweight and practical solution for cooking in the wild, it is naturally less durable than an iron pot and can only be used a limited number of times. Its smaller size also limits the number of portions you can cook at one go.

There are several special items in the game which are commonly called tools. Their use varies widely as does the method of application.
Some of the tools are used manually by using [a]pply command, and some are required upon crafting or building something.
The most common tools are described here:

TRAPS, PUNT, PADDLE, SESTA,
NET, NETTING NEEDLE, FISHING ROD, FISHHOOK, LIPPO,
SEWING NEEDLE, TORCH, SHINGLE, SHOVEL, GRAINFLAIL,
POT, BIRCH-BARK POT, WOODEN CANTEEN,
SKIS, SKI POLE,
VASTA,
SPINDLE.
entries.translation:
Pelissä on monia erikoisesineitä, joita kutsutaan yleisesti työkaluiksi. Niiden käyttötavat ja käyttöönotto vaihtelevat paljon.
Joitakin käytetään käsin käyttökomennolla [a], toisia tarvitaan esineiden valmistukseen tai rakentamiseen.
Tavallisimmat työkalut kuvataan täällä:

ANSAT, RUUHI, MELA, SAUVOIN,
VERKKO, VERKKOKÄPY, ONKI, ONGENKOUKKU, LIPPO,
OMPELUNEULA, SOIHTU, PÄRE, LAPIO, RIUSTA,
PATA, TUOHIASTIA, PUULEILI,
SUKSET, SKI POLE,
VASTA,
VÄRTTINÄ.

entries.source:
Sewing needle is a fundamental tool for making and repairing clothes. The most handy sewing needles are made of iron
by blacksmiths, but they can be also crafted from animal bone.
entries.translation: Ompeluneula on vaatteiden tekemisen ja korjaamisen perustyökalu. Kätevimmät neulat ovat seppien valmistamia rautaneuloja, mutta niitä voi tehdä myös eläimen luusta.

entries.source:
Fishhook is attached to the line of a fishing rod and it is the part that actually catches the fish. Fishhooks can be made of wood, bone and iron. Iron hooks are the best kind, then come the bone hooks. Wooden hooks are the least effective and usually relied on only in survival situation.

Fishhooks may snap off as the line wears out from use, especially around the hook. This wear is relative to the number and size of the fish that have nibbled the line over time. You can use a spare fishhook to repair a fishing rod with no hook. First [a]pply the fishhook, and then select a fishing rod to repair.
If you wish to remove a fishhook from a fishing rod then [a]pply a fishing rod when you are on dry land away from open water.

Netting needle is a wooden tool used to make nets. It is quite simple but essential tool that allows 
weaving the net with proper knots and forming a tightly fastened mesh of uniform size.

A spindle is a tool made from wood used for spinning plant fibres into yarn.
All the fibre processing is carried out by using your TEXTILECRAFT skill.

Lippo is a kind of a dip net used for catching fish from rapids and shallow waters. Fishing with a lippo is especially effective only at certain times of the year; when the fish to be caught are migrating upstream to their spawning locations, and during the active spawning period. Thus, the most common fish that are caught with the lippo, are the migratory salmon and lavaret.

A Lippo is constructed in such a way that it has a wooden hoop into which multiple small birch saplings are tied to. These saplings are tied together at their open ends, so that they form a net like construction around the hoop. The hoop with a net is then fixed to a long wooden pole.

Fishing with a lippo in the rivers and rapids is done by standing on rocks in the river. The location is often suitable when there are several rocks around as these are the usual places where both resting and spawning river fish are around and can be caught.
The lippo is lowered into the water, down to the bottom, and carefully dragged around in order to catch resting or spawning fish into its hoop. Successful lippo fishing is greatly based on knowledge of the locations where the fish might dwell. Start using your lippo either by using the fishing skill or by applying the lippo from the inventory.

Additionally, a lippo can also be used from the shore to catch spawning pikes or breams.
entries.translation:
Lippo on haavin kaltainen väline, jolla pyydetään kaloja koskista ja matalista vesistä. Lippokalastus on erityisen tehokasta vain tiettyinä vuodenaikoina: kalojen noustessa ylävirtaan kutupaikoilleen sekä aktiivisen kudun aikana. Tavallisimmat lippokalat ovatkin vaeltavat lohet ja siiat.

Lipon puuvanteeseen sidotaan useita pieniä koivuntaimia. Niiden vapaat päät sidotaan yhteen niin, että vanteen ympärille muodostuu verkkomainen rakenne. Kehys kiinnitetään pitkään puuvarteen.

Joissa ja koskissa lipotaan joen kivillä seisten. Paikka on usein sopiva, kun ympärillä on useita kiviä: niiden luona jokikalat tavallisesti lepäävät ja kutevat.
Lippo lasketaan pohjaan ja sitä vedetään varovasti ympäriinsä, jotta lepäävät tai kutevat kalat joutuvat sen kehään. Onnistuminen perustuu suurelta osin kalojen oleskelupaikkojen tuntemukseen. Aloita lippoaminen kalastustaidolla tai käyttämällä lippoa tavaraluettelosta.

Lipolla voi myös pyytää kutevia haukia ja lahnoja rannalta. // added & updated Jan-23-2016 // proofred Aug-31-2023 //

entries.source:
A common tool for active fishing. You can start angling with a fishing rod either by using the fishing skill or by applying the fishing rod from the inventory. Although it is not necessary to bait the fishhook when you start an angling session, an empty hook is far less attractive to nibble on, than one with a bit of food.

You can use pretty much any food item as a bait. Predatory fish species favour raw meat and fish, but for example crumbs of bread may also work with some fish. You can also use a whole small fish, eg. roach or perch, in order to attract a bigger predatory fish.

The type of fish caught when rod fishing is quite dependant on the baits used. It's not likely that you'll catch a pike with an empty hook, but having a small roach as bait might work. And that small roach may have been caught with quite moderate bait, such as bread crumbs, or even with some tasty vegetation.

Nets are tools for passive fishing. They are set and left in the water for a day or two, and then retrieved hopefully with some fish caught in it. A common net in the game is about 8 meters long and 2 meters deep with a 5 centimeter mesh. This is a size a lone fisher can easily handle.

Nets can be set either by using the fishing skill or by applying the net from the inventory. To retrieve a net you can simply pick it up.

Every time a net is set and retrieved it wears out a bit, and the bigger the catch, the more it can damage the net. How fast a net wears out depends greatly on your fishing skills. A talented fisher can handle the net so that it doesn't get tangled upon setting or retrieving, or unnecessarily damaged upon releasing the fish. A novice fisherman is prone to handle the net in a more clumsy fashion which results in more wear and tear.

Making a net is a laborious task and they were usually woven indoors during wintertime. Yarn is naturally required in substantial amounts, and some stronger cordage for the supporting structure, as well as the float and weight lines. The floats were usually made of birch-bark and rocks were used as weights. In the finest nets, the rock weights were wrapped in birch-bark pockets for a more durable construction.
entries.translation:
Verkot ovat passiivisen kalastuksen välineitä. Ne lasketaan veteen päiväksi tai kahdeksi ja nostetaan sitten, toivottavasti saaliin kanssa. Tavallinen pelin verkko on noin kahdeksan metriä pitkä ja kaksi metriä syvä, ja sen silmäkoko on viisi senttimetriä. Tällainen verkko on yksinäisen kalastajan helppo käsitellä.
